feats.name: Aberrant Dragonmark
entries: You have manifested an aberrant dragonmark. Determine its appearance and the flaw associated with it. You gain the following benefits:

items: You learn a {@filter cantrip of your choice from the sorcerer spell list|spells|level=0|class=Sorcerer}. In addition, choose a {@filter 1st-level spell from the sorcerer spell list|spells|level=1|class=Sorcerer}. You learn that spell and can cast it through your mark. Once you cast it, you must finish a short or long rest before you can cast it again through the mark. Constitution is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

When you cast the 1st-level spell through your mark, you can expend one of your Hit Dice and roll it. If you roll an even number, you gain a number of temporary hit points equal to the number rolled. If you roll an odd number, one random creature within 30 feet of you (not including you) takes force damage equal to the number rolled. If no other creatures are in range, you take the damage.

entries: You also develop a random flaw from the Aberrant Dragonmark Flaws table.

entries.caption: Aberrant Dragonmark Flaws
rows: Your mark is a source of constant physical pain.
Your mark whispers to you. Its meaning can be unclear.
When you're stressed, the mark hisses audibly.
The skin around the mark is burned, scaly, or withered.
You have a mood swing any time you use your mark.
Your looks change slightly whenever you use the mark.
You have horrific nightmares after you use your mark.

entries.name: Option: Greater Aberrant Powers
entries: At the DM's option, a character who has the Aberrant Dragonmark feat has a chance of manifesting greater power. Upon reaching 10th level, such a character has a {@chance 10} chance of gaining an {@filter epic boon|rewards|type=boon} from among the options in chapter 7 of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}. If the character fails to gain a boon, they have a {@chance 10} chance the next time they gain a level.

If the character gains a boon, the DM chooses it or determines it randomly. The character also permanently loses one of their Hit Dice, and their hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to a roll of that die plus their Constitution modifier (minimum reduction of 1). This reduction can't be reversed by any means.
entries_es: En la opción de DM, un personaje que tiene la hazaña Dragonmark Aberrant tiene la oportunidad de manifestar un mayor poder. Al alcanzar el décimo nivel, dicho personaje tiene una [[TAG0] posibilidad de obtener una {@filter epic boon|rewards|type=boon} de entre las opciones en el capítulo 7 del {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}]. Si el personaje no consigue ganar un boon, tienen una oportunidad [[TAG0] la próxima vez que ganan un nivel.

Si el personaje gana un boón, el DM lo elige o lo determina aleatoriamente. El personaje también pierde permanentemente uno de sus dados de éxito, y su máximo punto de éxito se reduce por una cantidad igual a un tirada de ese die más su modificador de Constitución (reducción mínima de 1). Esta reducción no puede ser revertida por ningún medio.

feats.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: Increase one ability score of your choice by 2, or increase two ability scores of your choice by 1. This feat can't increase an ability score above 20.

entries.name: Repeatable
entries: You can take this feat more than once.
entries_es: Puedes tomar esta hazaña más de una vez.

feats.name: Actor
entries: Skilled at mimicry and dramatics, you gain the following benefits:

items: You have advantage on Charisma ({@skill Deception}) and Charisma ({@skill Performance}) checks when trying to pass yourself off as a different person.

You can mimic the speech of another person or the sounds made by other creatures. You must have heard the person speaking, or heard the creature make the sound, for at least 1 minute. A successful Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check contested by your Charisma ({@skill Deception}) check allows a listener to determine that the effect is faked.

entries_es: Habilidos en la imitación y los dramáticos, obtiene los siguientes beneficios:

items: You have advantage on Charisma ({@skill Deception}) and Charisma ({@skill Performance}) checks when trying to pass yourself off as a different person.

You can mimic the speech of another person or the sounds made by other creatures. You must have heard the person speaking, or heard the creature make the sound, for at least 1 minute. A successful Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) check contested by your Charisma ({@skill Deception}) check allows a listener to determine that the effect is faked.

feats.name: Actor
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Impersonation
entries: While you're disguised as a real or fictional person, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Charisma ({@skill Deception|XPHB} or {@skill Performance|XPHB}) checks to convince others that you are that person.
entries_es: Mientras usted está disfrazado como una persona real o ficticia, usted tiene {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} en Charisma ([TAG1]] o {@skill Performance|XPHB}) cheques para convencer a otros de que usted es esa persona.

entries.name: Mimicry
entries: You can mimic the sounds of other creatures, including speech. A creature that hears the mimicry must succeed on a Wisdom ({@skill Insight|XPHB}) check to determine the effect is faked ({@dc 8} plus your Charisma modifier and {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}).
entries_es: Puedes imitar los sonidos de otras criaturas, incluyendo el discurso. Una criatura que oye la imitación debe tener éxito en un cheque de Sabiduría ([TAG0]]) para determinar el efecto es falso ([TAG1]] más su modificador de Charisma y {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}).

feats.name: Adept of the Black Robes

feat: initiate of high sorcery|dsotdq|initiate of high sorcery (nuitari)

entries: You chose the moon Nuitari to influence your magic, and your ambition and loyalty to the Order of the Black Robes have been recognized, granting you these benefits:

items.name: Ambitious Magic
entries: You learn one 2nd-level spell of your choice. The {@filter 2nd-level spell|spells|level=2|school=E;N} must be from the enchantment or necromancy school of magic. You can cast this feat's 2nd-level spell without a spell slot, and you must finish a long rest before you can cast it in this way again. You can also cast this spell using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spell's spellcasting ability is the one chosen when you gained the {@feat Initiate of High Sorcery|DSotDQ} feat.
entries_es: Aprendes un hechizo de segundo nivel de tu elección. La {@filter 2nd-level spell|spells|level=2|school=E;N} debe ser de la escuela de encantamiento o necromancia de la magia. Usted puede lanzar el hechizo de 2o nivel de esta hazaña sin una tragaperras de hechizo, y debe terminar un largo descanso antes de que pueda echarlo de nuevo. También puede lanzar este hechizo usando ranuras de hechizo que tiene del nivel apropiado. La habilidad de spellcasting del hechizo es la elegida cuando ganaste la hazaña {@feat Initiate of High Sorcery|DSotDQ}.

items.name: Life Channel
entries: You can channel your life force into the power of your magic. When a creature you can see within 60 feet of you fails a saving throw against a spell that deals damage that you cast, you can expend a number of Hit Dice equal to the level of the spell. Roll the expended Hit Dice and add them together. The damage that the creature takes increases by an amount equal to that total.
entries_es: Puedes canalizar tu fuerza vital al poder de tu magia. Cuando una criatura que se puede ver dentro de 60 pies de usted falla una tirada de salvación contra un hechizo que trata el daño que usted lanzó, usted puede gastar un número de Hit Dice igual al nivel del hechizo. Roll the expended Hit Dice y agreguelos juntos. El daño que la criatura toma aumenta por una cantidad igual a ese total.

items.name: Magical Balance
entries: When you make an attack roll or an ability check and roll a 9 or lower on the {@dice d20}, you can balance fate and treat the roll as a 10. You can balance fate in this way a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
entries_es: Cuando usted hace un tirada de ataque o un cheque de habilidad y tirar un 9 o inferior en el {@dice d20}, usted puede equilibrar el destino y tratar el rollo como un 10. Usted puede equilibrar el destino de esta manera un número de veces igual a su prima de competencia, y usted recupera todos los usos gastados cuando se termina un descanso largo.

entries: You can channel cosmic forces of order to gain these benefits:

items.name: Stasis Strike
entries: Once per turn, when you damage a creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself, you can deal an extra {@damage 1d8} force damage to the target, and it must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC equal to 8 + your proficiency bonus + the modifier of the spellcasting ability you chose for the Scion of the Outer Planes feat) as spectral bindings try to ensnare it. On a successful save, the target escapes. On a failed save, the target has the restrained condition until the start of your next turn. These bindings manifest as chains or some other symbol of stasis. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

Con un salvación exitoso, el objetivo se escapa. En un salvación fallido, el objetivo tiene la condición restringida hasta el comienzo de su próximo turno. Estas uniones se manifiestan como cadenas o algún otro símbolo de estasis. Usted puede utilizar este beneficio un número de veces igual a su prima de competencia, y usted recupera todos los usos gastados cuando usted termina un descanso largo.

feats.name: Boon of Fate
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Improve Fate
entries: When you or another creature within 60 feet of you succeeds on or fails a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}, you can roll {@dice 2d4} and apply the total rolled as a bonus or penalty to the {@dice d20} roll. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you roll {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} or finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

feats.name: Boon of Fluid Forms
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Shapechanger
entries: You can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to shape-shift into a Beast, Humanoid, or Monstrosity with a {@variantrule Challenge Rating|XPHB} no higher than 10. When you shape-shift, you gain a number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} of the form. The shape-shifting effect lasts for 1 hour, and it ends early if you have no {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} left or if you take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to return to your true form.

Your game statistics are replaced by the stat block of the chosen form, but you retain your creature type; alignment; personality; Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}; {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB}; proficiencies; and ability to communicate. If you have the Spellcasting or Pact Magic feature, you retain it too. Upon shape-shifting, you determine whether your equipment drops to the ground or changes in size and shape to fit the new form while you're in it.
Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
entries_es: Usted puede tomar una [[TAG0] acción para cambiar de forma en una Bestia, Humanoid, o la monstruosidad con un {@variantrule Challenge Rating|XPHB} no superior a 10. Cuando cambias de forma, obtienes un número de {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} igual al {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} de la forma. El efecto de cambio de forma dura 1 hora, y termina temprano si no te queda {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} o si tomas una acción {@action Magic|XPHB} para volver a tu verdadera forma.

Sus estadísticas de juego son reemplazadas por el bloque de puestos de la forma elegida, pero usted conserva su tipo de criatura; alineación; personalidad; inteligencia, sabiduría y puntuaciones de Charisma; {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}; {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB}]; competencias; y capacidad de comunicarse. Si tienes la función Spellcasting o Pact Magic, también la conservas. Al cambiar de forma, usted determina si su equipo cae al suelo o cambia de tamaño y forma para adaptarse a la nueva forma mientras usted está en ella.
Una vez que utilice este beneficio, no puede hacerlo de nuevo hasta que termine un {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.name: Hardy Transformation
entries: When you gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} when you shape-shift, increase that number of {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} by 20.
entries_es: Cuando usted gana {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} cuando usted cambia de forma, aumentar ese número de {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} por 20.

entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Last Stand
entries: When you would be reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, you can drop to 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} instead and regain a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to half your {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum. Usted recupera todos los dados gastados cuando termina un {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

feats.name: Boon of Revelry
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Inspire Dance
entries: You always have the {@spell Otto's Irresistible Dance|XPHB} spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it that way when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.
When you cast the spell, it requires no spell components, and taking damage doesn't break your {@status Concentration|XPHB} on it.
entries_es: Siempre tienes el hechizo [[TAG0] preparado. Puedes echarlo una vez sin una ranura de hechizo, y recuperas la capacidad de lanzarlo de esa manera cuando termines una {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. También puede lanzar el hechizo usando cualquier ranura de hechizo que tenga del nivel apropiado.
Cuando usted lanza el hechizo, no requiere componentes de hechizo, y tomar daño no rompe su {@status Concentration|XPHB}] en él.

entries.name: Sing Out
entries: While a creature that failed its saving throw against your {@spell Otto's Irresistible Dance|XPHB} has the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} condition from that spell, it can't cast spells with Verbal components, and it sings delightful nonsense if it can sing.
entries_es: Mientras una criatura que fracasó sutirada de salvación en contra de su {@spell Otto's Irresistible Dance|XPHB} tiene la condición {@condition Charmed|XPHB} de ese hechizo, no puede lanzar hechizos con componentes Verbal, y canta una deliciosa tontería si puede cantar.

entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you radiate a 30-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} of {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} that is sunlight. If any of the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}'s area overlaps with an area of {@spell Darkness|XPHB} created by a spell, that spell is dispelled. The {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} lasts until you dismiss it (no action required), die, or have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.
entries.name_es: Presencia de la luz del día
entries_es: Como {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, irradias una luz solar de 30 pies {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}]. Si alguna de la zona {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} se superpone con un área de {@spell Darkness|XPHB} creada por un hechizo, ese hechizo se disipa. La {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} dura hasta que la despida (no se requiere acción), muere, o tenga la condición [[TAG6].

entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Merge with Shadows
entries: While within {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} or {@variantrule Darkness|XPHB}, you can give yourself the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. feats.name: Bountiful Luck
entries: Your people have extraordinary luck, which you have learned to mystically lend to your companions when you see them falter. You're not sure how you do it; you just wish it, and it happens. Surely a sign of fortune's favor!

When an ally you can see within 30 feet of you rolls a 1 on the {@dice d20} for an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw, you can use your reaction to let the ally reroll the die. The ally must use the new roll.
When you use this ability, you can't use your Lucky racial trait before the end of your next turn.
entries_es: Tu gente tiene una suerte extraordinaria, que has aprendido a prestar misticamente a tus compañeros cuando los ves falter. No estás seguro de cómo lo haces; sólo lo deseas, y sucede. ¡Un signo del favor de la fortuna!

Cuando un aliado puede ver dentro de 30 pies de usted roda un 1 en el {@dice d20} para un tirada de ataque, un cheque de habilidad, o una tirada de salvación, puede utilizar su reacción para permitir que el aliado rerolle la muerte. El aliado debe usar el nuevo rollo.
Cuando usas esta habilidad, no puedes usar tu rasgo racial Lucky antes del final de tu próximo turno.

feats.name: Cartomancer
entries: You have learned to channel your magic through a deck of cards. You can use a card deck as your spellcasting focus, and you gain the following benefits:

items.name: Card Tricks
entries: You learn the {@spell Prestidigitation} cantrip and can use it to create illusions that duplicate the effects of stage magic. When you use {@spell Prestidigitation} in this way, you can conceal the verbal and somatic components of the spell as ordinary conversation and card handling.
entries_es: Usted aprende el {@spell Prestidigitation} puede navegar y puede utilizarlo para crear ilusiones que duplican los efectos de la magia del escenario. Cuando usas {@spell Prestidigitation} de esta manera, puedes ocultar los componentes verbales y somáticos del hechizo como conversación ordinaria y manejo de tarjetas.

items.name: Hidden Ace
entries: When you finish a long rest, you can choose one spell from your class's spell list and imbue that spell into a card. The chosen spell must have a casting time of 1 action, and it must be a level for which you have spell slots. The card remains imbued with this spell for 8 hours. While the card is imbued with the spell, you can use a bonus action to flourish the card and cast the spell within. The card then immediately loses its magic.
entries_es: Cuando termines un largo descanso, puedes elegir un hechizo de la lista de hechizos de tu clase e imbuir ese hechizo en una tarjeta. El hechizo elegido debe tener un tiempo de casting de 1 acción, y debe ser un nivel para el cual usted tiene ranuras de hechizo. La tarjeta permanece imbuida con este hechizo durante 8 horas. Mientras la tarjeta está imbuida con el hechizo, usted puede utilizar una acción de bonificación para florecer la tarjeta y lanzar el hechizo dentro. La tarjeta pierde inmediatamente su magia.

feats.name: Charger
entries: When you use your action to {@action Dash}, you can use a bonus action to make one melee weapon attack or to {@action shove} a creature.

If you move at least 10 feet in a straight line immediately before taking this bonus action, you either gain a +5 bonus to the attack's damage roll (if you chose to make a melee attack and hit) or push the target up to 10 feet away from you (if you chose to shove and you succeed).
entries_es: Cuando usted utiliza su acción a {@action Dash}, usted puede utilizar una acción de bonificación para hacer un ataque de arma melee o a [[TAG1] una criatura.

Si usted se mueve al menos 10 pies en una línea recta inmediatamente antes de tomar esta acción de bonificación, usted gana un bono +5 al tirada de daño del ataque (si usted decide hacer un ataque de melee y golpe) o empujar el objetivo hasta 10 pies de distancia de usted (si usted elige empujar y tiene éxito).

entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Charge Attack
entries: If you move at least 10 feet in a straight line toward a target immediately before hitting it with a melee attack roll as part of the {@action Attack|XPHB} action, choose one of the following effects: gain a {@dice 1d8} bonus to the attack's damage roll, or push the target up to 10 feet away if it is no more than one size larger than you. You can use this benefit only once on each of your turns.

feats.name: Chef
entries: Time spent mastering the culinary arts has paid off, granting you the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency with {@item cook's utensils|phb} if you don't already have it.

As part of a short rest, you can cook special food, provided you have ingredients and {@item cook's utensils|phb} on hand. You can prepare enough of this food for a number of creatures equal to 4 + your proficiency bonus. At the end of the short rest, any creature who eats the food and spends one or more Hit Dice to regain hit points regains an extra {@dice 1d8} hit points.

With one hour of work or when you finish a long rest, you can cook a number of treats equal to your proficiency bonus. These special treats last 8 hours after being made. A creature can use a bonus action to eat one of those treats to gain temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus.

feats.name: Cohort of Chaos

feat: scion of the outer planes|sato|scion of the outer planes (chaotic outer plane)

entries: You can channel cosmic forces of chaos to gain these benefits:

items.name: Chaotic Flare
entries: When you roll a 1 or a 20 on an attack roll or a saving throw, the magic of chaos flows through you. Roll a d4 and consult the Chaotic Flares table to determine what happens. A flare lasts until the end of your next turn, and a new flare can't occur until after the first flare ends.

entries.caption: Chaotic Flares
rows: {@b Battle Fury.} A creature of your choice that you can see is filled with reckless fury. It has advantage on attack rolls and disadvantage on ability checks.

{@b Disruption Field.} Waves of energy ripple around you. Every creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of you, or that moves into that area for the first time on a turn, takes {@damage 1d8} force damage.

{@b Unbound.} When you move, you can use some or all of your walking speed to teleport yourself once, along with any equipment you're wearing or carrying, up to the distance used to an unoccupied space that you can see.
{@b Wailing Winds.} Winds swirl in a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on you. You and any other creatures in that area have disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws.

Enrolla un d4 y consulta la tabla de bengalas caóticas para determinar qué sucede. Una bengala dura hasta el final de tu próximo turno, y una nueva bengala no puede ocurrir hasta después de que termine la primera bengala.

rows: {@b Battle Fury.} A creature of your choice that you can see is filled with reckless fury. It has advantage on attack rolls and disadvantage on ability checks.

{@b Disruption Field.} Waves of energy ripple around you. Every creature that starts its turn within 5 feet of you, or that moves into that area for the first time on a turn, takes {@damage 1d8} force damage.

{@b Unbound.} When you move, you can use some or all of your walking speed to teleport yourself once, along with any equipment you're wearing or carrying, up to the distance used to an unoccupied space that you can see.
{@b Wailing Winds.} Winds swirl in a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on you. You and any other creatures in that area have disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws.

feats.name: Crossbow Expert
entries: Thanks to extensive practice with the crossbow, you gain the following benefits:

items: You ignore the loading quality of crossbows with which you are proficient.
Being within 5 feet of a hostile creature doesn't impose disadvantage on your ranged attack rolls.
When you use the {@action Attack} action and attack with a one-handed weapon, you can use a bonus action to attack with a {@item hand crossbow|phb} you are holding.

entries_es: Gracias a la práctica extensa con el arco cruzado, obtiene los siguientes beneficios:

items: You ignore the loading quality of crossbows with which you are proficient.
Being within 5 feet of a hostile creature doesn't impose disadvantage on your ranged attack rolls.
When you use the {@action Attack} action and attack with a one-handed weapon, you can use a bonus action to attack with a {@item hand crossbow|phb} you are holding.

If you're holding one of them, you can load a piece of ammunition into it even if you lack a free hand.

feats.name: Cruel
entries: The challenges and struggles you've faced throughout your life have led you to delight in inflicting pain and anguish upon others. You gain a number of cruelty dice equal to your proficiency bonus. Your cruelty dice are {@dice d6|d6s}. You can roll only one cruelty die per turn, and a cruelty die is spent when you roll it.
You can roll a cruelty die under any of the following circumstances, with the indicated result:

items: When you deal damage to a creature, spend one cruelty die to deal extra damage to the creature equal to the roll.
When you score a critical hit, spend one cruelty die to gain temporary hit points equal to the roll.
When you make a Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) check, spend one cruelty die and add the roll to your check.

entries: You regain all spent cruelty dice when you finish a {@quickref resting|PHB|2|0|long rest}.
entries_es: Los desafíos y luchas que has enfrentado a lo largo de tu vida te han llevado a deleitarte infligiendo dolor y angustia a otros. Usted gana un número de dados de crueldad igual a su prima de competencia. Tus dados de crueldad son {@dice d6|d6s}. Usted puede tirar sólo una crueldad muere por turno, y una crueldad muere se gasta cuando usted la rueda.
Usted puede tirar una crueldad muere bajo cualquiera de las siguientes circunstancias, con el resultado indicado:

items: When you deal damage to a creature, spend one cruelty die to deal extra damage to the creature equal to the roll.
When you score a critical hit, spend one cruelty die to gain temporary hit points equal to the roll.
When you make a Charisma ({@skill Intimidation}) check, spend one cruelty die and add the roll to your check.

entries_es: Recuperas todos los dados de crueldad gastados cuando terminas un {@quickref resting|PHB|2|0|long rest}.

feats.name: Crusher
entries: You are practiced in the art of crushing your enemies, granting you the following benefits:

items: Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an attack that deals bludgeoning damage, you can move it 5 feet to an unoccupied space, provided the target is no more than one size larger than you.
When you score a critical hit that deals bludgeoning damage to a creature, attack rolls against that creature are made with advantage until the start of your next turn.

entries_es: Se practica en el arte de aplastar a sus enemigos, concediéndole los siguientes beneficios:

items: Once per turn, when you hit a creature with an attack that deals bludgeoning damage, you can move it 5 feet to an unoccupied space, provided the target is no more than one size larger than you.
When you score a critical hit that deals bludgeoning damage to a creature, attack rolls against that creature are made with advantage until the start of your next turn.

feats.name: Cult of the Dragon Initiate
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Dragon's Tongue
entries: You know Draconic. If you already know Draconic when you select this feat, you instead learn one language of your choice from the language tables in the Player's Handbook or Chapter 2 of this book.
entries_es: Conoces a Draconic. Si ya sabes Draconic cuando seleccionas esta hazaña, en lugar de ello aprendes un idioma de tu elección de las tablas de idiomas del Manual del Jugador o del Capítulo 2 de este libro.

entries.name: Dragon's Terror
entries: You can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to instill terror in a creature you can see within 30 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 plus your Wisdom modifier and {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}) or have the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition until the end of your next turn. If the target succeeds on the save or when the effect ends for a target, the target is immune to this effect for 24 hours.
entries_es: Puedes tomar una acción [[TAG0] para inculcar el terror en una criatura que puedas ver a menos de 30 pies de ti mismo. El objetivo debe tener éxito en una tirada de salvación de Sabiduría (DC 8 más su modificador de Sabiduría y {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}) o tener la condición {@condition Frightened|XPHB} hasta el final de su próximo turno. Si el objetivo tiene éxito en el salvación o cuando el efecto termina para un objetivo, el objetivo es inmune a este efecto durante 24 horas.

entries.name: Inspired by Fear
entries: When you cause a creature to have the {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition and you are the source of its fear, you can gain {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB} if you lack it. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
entries_es: Cuando usted hace que una criatura tenga la condición {@condition Frightened|XPHB} y usted es la fuente de su miedo, usted puede ganar {@variantrule Heroic Inspiration|XPHB} si le falta. Una vez que utilice este beneficio, no puede utilizarlo de nuevo hasta que termine un {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} o {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}].

feats.name: Defense
entries: While you're wearing Light, Medium, or Heavy armor, you gain a +1 bonus to {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB}.
entries_es: Mientras usted está usando Luz, Media o Armadura Pesada, usted gana un bono +1 a {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB}.

feats.name: Defensive Duelist
entries: When you are wielding a finesse weapon with which you are proficient and another creature hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to add your proficiency bonus to your AC for that attack, potentially causing the attack to miss you.
entries_es: Cuando estás manipulando un arma fina con la que eres competente y otra criatura te golpea con un simple ataque, puedes usar tu reacción para añadir tu bonificación de competencia a tu AC para ese ataque, causando potencialmente que el ataque te pierda.

feats.name: Defensive Duelist
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Parry
entries: If you're holding a Finesse weapon and another creature hits you with a melee attack, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to add your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} to your {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB}, potentially causing the attack to miss you. You gain this bonus to your AC against melee attacks until the start of your next turn.
entries_es: Si estás sosteniendo un arma de Finesse y otra criatura te golpea con un simple ataque, puedes tomar un {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} para añadir tu {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}] a tu {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB}, potencialmente causando que el ataque te pierda. Usted gana este bono a su AC contra los ataques de melee hasta el comienzo de su próximo turno.

Usted gana este bono a su AC contra los ataques de melee hasta el comienzo de su próximo turno.

feats.name: Divinely Favored
entries: A god chose you to carry a spark of their power.

You learn one cantrip of your choice from the {@filter cleric spell list|spells|level=0|class=cleric} and one 1st-level spell based on the alignment of your character, as specified in the Alignment Spells table below. You also learn the {@spell augury} spell.

You can cast the chosen 1st-level spell and the {@spell augury} spell without a spell slot, and you must finish a long rest before you can cast either of these spells in this way again. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level.
Your spellcasting ability for this feat's spells is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (choose when you select this feat).
In addition, you can use a holy symbol as a spellcasting focus for any spell you cast that uses the spellcasting ability you choose when you select this feat.
entries_es: Un dios te eligió para llevar una chispa de su poder.

Usted aprende un cantrip de su elección desde el {@filter cleric spell list|spells|level=0|class=cleric} y un hechizo de primer nivel basado en la alineación de su personaje, como se especifica en la tabla Spells de alineación a continuación. También aprende el hechizo {@spell augury}.

Usted puede lanzar el hechizo elegido de primer nivel y el hechizo {@spell augury} sin una tragaperras de hechizo, y debe terminar un descanso largo antes de que usted pueda lanzar cualquiera de estos hechizos de esta manera de nuevo. También puede lanzar estos hechizos usando ranuras de hechizo que tiene del nivel apropiado.
Su capacidad de spellcasting para los hechizos de esta hazaña es Inteligencia, Sabiduría o Charisma (elegir cuando se selecciona esta hazaña).

Además, usted puede utilizar un símbolo santo como un foco de spellcasting para cualquier hechizo que usted lanza que utiliza la habilidad de spellcasting que usted elige cuando se selecciona esta hazaña.

feats.name: Dragon Fear
entries: When angered, you radiate menace. You gain the following benefits:

items: Instead of exhaling destructive energy, you can expend a use of your Breath Weapon trait to roar, forcing each creature of your choice within 30 feet of you to make a Wisdom saving throw ({@dc 8} + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier). A target automatically succeeds on the save if it can't hear or see you. On a failed save, a target becomes {@condition frightened} of you for 1 minute. If the {@condition frightened} target takes any damage, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entries_es: Cuando te enojas, irradias amenaza. Usted gana los siguientes beneficios:

items: Instead of exhaling destructive energy, you can expend a use of your Breath Weapon trait to roar, forcing each creature of your choice within 30 feet of you to make a Wisdom saving throw ({@dc 8} + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier). A target automatically succeeds on the save if it can't hear or see you. On a failed save, a target becomes {@condition frightened} of you for 1 minute. If the {@condition frightened} target takes any damage, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

feats.name: Dragon Hide
entries: You manifest scales and claws reminiscent of your draconic ancestors. You gain the following benefits:

items: Your scales harden. While you aren't wearing armor, you can calculate your AC as 13 + your Destreza modifier. You can use a shield and still gain this benefit.

You grow retractable claws from the tips of your fingers. Extending or retracting the claws requires no action. The claws are natural weapons, which you can use to make unarmed strikes. If you hit with them, you deal slashing damage equal to {@damage 1d4} + your Strength modifier, instead of the normal bludgeoning damage for an unarmed strike.

entries_es: Manifiestas escalas y garras que recuerdan a tus antepasados dracónicos. Usted gana los siguientes beneficios:

entries_es: Cuando usted hace daño a una criatura como parte de la acción de ataque o magia en su turno, usted puede utilizar el beneficio del terror del dragón del Culto del Iniciado Dragón la hazaña como un [[TAG0] este giro.

feats.name: Drow High Magic
entries: You learn more of the magic typical of dark elves. You learn the {@spell detect magic} spell and can cast it at will, without expending a spell slot. You also learn {@spell levitate} and {@spell dispel magic}, each of which you can cast once without expending a spell slot. You regain the ability to cast those two spells in this way when you finish a long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for all three spells.
entries_es: Aprendes más de la magia típica de los elfos oscuros. Usted aprende el hechizo {@spell detect magic} y puede lanzarlo a voluntad, sin gastar una ranura de hechizo. También se aprende {@spell levitate} y {@spell dispel magic}, cada uno de los cuales se puede lanzar una vez sin gastar una ranura de hechizo. Recuperas la capacidad de lanzar esos dos hechizos de esta manera cuando terminas un largo descanso. Charisma es tu habilidad de spellcasting para los tres hechizos.

feats.name: Druidic Warrior

otherSummary.entry: When Gaining the Level 2 Ranger "Fighting Style" Feature

entries: You learn two {@filter Druid cantrips|spells|level=0|class=druid} of your choice. {@spell Guidance|XPHB} and {@spell Starry Wisp|XPHB} are recommended. The chosen cantrips count as Ranger spells for you, and Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for them. Whenever you gain a Ranger level, you can replace one of these cantrips with another Druid cantrip.
entries_es: Aprendes dos {@filter Druid cantrips|spells|level=0|class=druid} de tu elección. {@spell Guidance|XPHB} y {@spell Starry Wisp|XPHB}] son recomendados. Los cantrips elegidos cuentan como hechizos Ranger para usted, y la Sabiduría es su habilidad de spellcasting para ellos. Cada vez que obtienes un nivel de Ranger, puedes reemplazar uno de estos botes con otro bote Druid.

feats.name: Dual Wielder
entries: You master fighting with two weapons, gaining the following benefits:

items: You gain a +1 bonus to AC while you are wielding a separate melee weapon in each hand.
You can use two-weapon fighting even when the one-handed melee weapons you are wielding aren't light.
You can draw or stow two one-handed weapons when you would normally be able to draw or stow only one.

entries_es: Usted domina la lucha con dos armas, ganando los siguientes beneficios:

items: You gain a +1 bonus to AC while you are wielding a separate melee weapon in each hand.
You can use two-weapon fighting even when the one-handed melee weapons you are wielding aren't light.
You can draw or stow two one-handed weapons when you would normally be able to draw or stow only one.

feats.name: Dual Wielder
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Enhanced Dual Wielding
entries: When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on your turn and attack with a weapon that has the {@itemProperty L|XPHB|Light} property, you can make one extra attack as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} later on the same turn with a different weapon, which must be a Melee weapon that lacks the {@itemProperty 2H|XPHB|Two-Handed} property. You don't add your ability modifier to the extra attack's damage unless that modifier is negative.
entries_es: Cuando usted toma la {@action Attack|XPHB} acción en su turno y ataque con un arma que tiene la propiedad {@itemProperty L|XPHB|Light}, usted puede hacer un ataque adicional como {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} más tarde en el mismo turno con un arma diferente, que debe ser un arma Melee que carece de la propiedad [[TAG3]. No agregas tu modificador de habilidad al daño del ataque extra a menos que ese modificador sea negativo.

entries.name: Quick Draw
entries: You can draw or stow two weapons that lack the {@itemProperty 2H|XPHB|Two-Handed} property when you would normally be able to draw or stow only one.
entries_es: Usted puede dibujar o picar dos armas que carecen de la propiedad [[TAG0] cuando usted normalmente sería capaz de dibujar o stow sólo uno.
Ganas los siguientes beneficios.

feats.name: Dueling
entries: When you're holding a Melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, you gain a +2 bonus to damage rolls with that weapon.
entries_es: Cuando tienes un arma Melee en una mano y ninguna otra arma, ganas un bono +2 para dañar rollos con ese arma.

feats.name: Dungeon Delver
entries: Alert to the hidden traps and secret doors found in many dungeons, you gain the following benefits:

items: You have advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) and Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) checks made to detect the presence of secret doors.
You have advantage on saving throws made to avoid or resist traps.
You have resistance to the damage dealt by traps.
Traveling at a fast pace doesn't impose the normal -5 penalty on your passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score.

entries_es: Alerta a las trampas ocultas y puertas secretas encontradas en muchas mazmorras, obtienes los siguientes beneficios:

items: You have advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) and Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) checks made to detect the presence of secret doors.
You have advantage on saving throws made to avoid or resist traps.
You have resistance to the damage dealt by traps.
Traveling at a fast pace doesn't impose the normal -5 penalty on your passive Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) score.

feats.name: Durable
entries: Hardy and resilient, you gain the following benefits:

items: When you roll a Hit Die to regain hit points, the minimum number of hit points you regain from the roll equals twice your Constitution modifier (minimum of 2).

entries_es: Hardy y resistente, obtiene los siguientes beneficios:

items: When you roll a Hit Die to regain hit points, the minimum number of hit points you regain from the roll equals twice your Constitution modifier (minimum of 2).

entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Defy Death
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB|Death Saving Throws}.
entries_es: Usted tiene {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} en {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|XPHB|Death Saving Throws}.

entries.name: Speedy Recovery
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can expend one of your {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB}, roll the die, and regain a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the roll.
entries_es: Como un {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, usted puede gastar uno de sus {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB}, tirar la muerte, y recuperar un número de {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} igual al rollo.
Ganas los siguientes beneficios.

feats.name: Dwarven Fortitude
entries: You have the blood of dwarf heroes flowing through your veins. You gain the following benefits:

items: Whenever you take the {@action Dodge} action in combat, you can spend one Hit Die to heal yourself. Roll the die, add your Constitution modifier, and regain a number of hit points equal to the total (minimum of 1).

entries_es: Tienes la sangre de héroes enanos fluyendo por tus venas. Usted gana los siguientes beneficios:

items: Whenever you take the {@action Dodge} action in combat, you can spend one Hit Die to heal yourself. Roll the die, add your Constitution modifier, and regain a number of hit points equal to the total (minimum of 1).

feats.name: Eldritch Adept
entries: Studying occult lore, you learn one {@filter Eldritch Invocation|optionalfeatures|Feature Type=EI} option of your choice from the warlock class. Your spellcasting ability for the invocation is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (choose when you select this feat). If the invocation has a prerequisite of any kind, you can choose that invocation only if you're a warlock who meets the prerequisite.
Whenever you gain a level, you can replace the invocation with another one from the warlock class.
entries_es: Estudiando lore oculto, usted aprende una opción [[TAG0] de su elección de la clase de bloque de guerra. Su capacidad de spellcasting para la invocación es Inteligencia, Sabiduría o Charisma (elegir cuando selecciona esta hazaña). Si la invocación tiene un requisito previo de cualquier tipo, usted puede elegir esa invocación sólo si usted es un bloque de guerra que cumple con el requisito previo.
Cada vez que usted gana un nivel, usted puede reemplazar la invocación con otro de la clase del bloque de guerra.

feats.name: Elemental Adept
entries: When you gain this feat, choose one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder.
Spells you cast ignore resistance to damage of the chosen type. In addition, when you roll damage for a spell you cast that deals damage of that type, you can treat any 1 on a damage die as a 2.
You can select this feat multiple times. Each time you do so, you must choose a different damage type.
entries_es: Cuando usted gana esta hazaña, elija uno de los siguientes tipos de daños: ácido, frío, fuego, relámpago o trueno.

Los discursos que lanzan ignoran la resistencia al daño del tipo elegido. Además, cuando usted hace tirar el daño por un hechizo que lanza que trata el daño de ese tipo, usted puede tratar cualquier 1 en un daño muere como un 2.
Puede seleccionar esta hazaña varias veces. Cada vez que lo hace, debe elegir un tipo de daño diferente.

feats.name: Elven Accuracy
entries: The accuracy of elves is legendary, especially that of elf archers and spellcasters. You have uncanny aim with attacks that rely on precision rather than brute force. You gain the following benefits:

items: Whenever you have advantage on an attack roll using Destreza, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma, you can reroll one of the dice once.

entries_es: La precisión de los elfos es legendaria, especialmente la de los arqueros elfos y los deletreadores. Tienes un objetivo incierto con ataques que dependen de la precisión en lugar de la fuerza bruta. Usted gana los siguientes beneficios:

items: Whenever you have advantage on an attack roll using Destreza, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma, you can reroll one of the dice once.

feats.name: Ember of the Fire Giant

feat: strike of the giants|BGG|strike of the giants (fire strike)

entries: You've manifested the fiery combat emblematic of fire giants, granting you the following benefits:

items.name: Born of Flame
entries: You have resistance to fire damage.
entries_es: Tienes resistencia al daño al fuego.

items.name: Searing Ignition
entries: When you take the {@action Attack} action on your turn, you can replace a single attack with a magical burst of flame. Each creature of your choice in a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on you must make a Destreza saving throw (DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + the modifier of the ability increased by this feat). On a failed save, a creature takes fire damage equal to {@damage 1d8} + your proficiency bonus, and it has the blinded condition until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage only. You can use your Searing Ignition a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus (but no more than once per turn), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
entries_es: Cuando tomes la acción [[TAG0] en tu turno, puedes reemplazar un solo ataque con una explosión mágica de llama. Cada criatura de su elección en una esfera de 15 pies-radius centrado en usted debe hacer una tirada de salvación de Destreza (DC es igual a 8 + su prima de competencia + el modificador de la capacidad aumentada por esta hazaña). En un salvación fallido, una criatura toma daño al fuego igual a {@damage 1d8} + su bonificación de competencia, y tiene la condición ciega hasta el comienzo de su próximo turno. Con un salvación exitoso, la criatura toma la mitad del daño sólo. Puede utilizar su Searing Ignition un número de veces igual a su bonificación de competencia (pero no más de una vez por turno), y recuperar todos los usos gastados cuando termine un descanso largo.

entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Speak with Animals
entries: You always have the {@spell Speak with Animals|XPHB} spell prepared and can cast it with any spell slots you have. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat). When you cast this spell as a {@variantrule Ritual|XPHB}, its duration is 8 hours.

Cuando usted lanza este hechizo como un {@variantrule Ritual|XPHB}, su duración es de 8 horas.

entries.name: Tag Team
entries: When you take the {@action Help|XPHB} action, you can switch places with a willing ally within 5 feet of yourself as part of that same action. This movement doesn't provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}. You can't use this benefit if the ally has the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

feats.name: Fade Away
entries: Your people are clever, with a knack for illusion magic. You have learned a magical trick for fading away when you suffer harm. You gain the following benefits:

items: Immediately after you take damage, you can use a reaction to magically become {@condition invisible} until the end of your next turn or until you attack, deal damage, or force someone to make a saving throw. Once you use this ability, you can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

entries_es: Tu gente es inteligente, con un cuchillo para magia de ilusión. Has aprendido un truco mágico para desaparecer cuando sufres daño. Usted gana los siguientes beneficios:

items: Immediately after you take damage, you can use a reaction to magically become {@condition invisible} until the end of your next turn or until you attack, deal damage, or force someone to make a saving throw. Once you use this ability, you can't do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

feats.name: Fairy Trickster
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Faerie Trod Trotter
entries: When you take the {@action Disengage|XPHB} action on your turn, {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} doesn't cost you extra movement for the rest of that turn.
entries_es: Cuando tomas la acción [[TAG0] en tu turno, {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB} no te cuesta el movimiento extra por el resto de ese giro.

entries.name: Flustering Strike
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack roll, you can attempt to fluster the target. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 plus the ability modifier of the score increased by this feat and your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}) or have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on saving throws until the end of your next turn.
You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

feats.name: Fey Teleportation
entries: Your study of high elven lore has unlocked fey power that few other elves possess, except your eladrin cousins. Drawing on your fey ancestry, you can momentarily stride through the Feywild to shorten your path from one place to another. You gain the following benefits:

items: You learn to speak, read, and write {@language Sylvan}.

You learn the {@spell misty step} spell and can cast it once without expending a spell slot. You regain the ability to cast it in this way when you finish a short or long rest. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

entries_es: Su estudio de la lora alta de Elven ha desbloqueado el poder fey que pocos otros elfos poseen, excepto sus primos eladrín. Dirigiendo en su ancestro fey, puede pasar momentáneamente por el Feywild para acortar su camino de un lugar a otro. Usted gana los siguientes beneficios:

items: You learn to speak, read, and write {@language Sylvan}.

You learn the {@spell misty step} spell and can cast it once without expending a spell slot. You regain the ability to cast it in this way when you finish a short or long rest. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

entries: Your exposure to the Feywild's magic has changed you, granting you the following benefits:

items: You learn the {@spell misty step} spell and one {@filter 1st-level spell|spells|level=1|school=E;D} of your choice. Once you cast either of these spells in this way, you can't cast that spell in this way again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spells' spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.

feats.name: Fighting Initiate
entries: Your martial training has helped you develop a particular style of fighting. As a result, you learn one {@filter Fighting Style|optionalfeatures|Feature Type=FS:F} option of your choice from the fighter class. If you already have a style, the one you choose must be different.
Whenever you reach a level that grants the Ability Score Improvement feature, you can replace this feat's fighting style with another one from the fighter class that you don't have.
entries_es: Su entrenamiento marcial le ha ayudado a desarrollar un estilo particular de lucha. Como resultado, usted aprende una opción [[TAG0] de su elección de la clase de luchador. Si ya tienes un estilo, el que elijas debe ser diferente.
Cada vez que alcanzas un nivel que otorga la función de mejora de puntuación de habilidad, puedes reemplazar el estilo de lucha de esta hazaña por otro de la clase de luchadores que no tienes.

feats.name: Flames of Phlegethos
entries: You learn to call on hellfire to serve your commands. You gain the following benefits:

items: When you roll fire damage for a spell you cast, you can reroll any roll of 1 on the fire damage dice, but you must use the new roll, even if it is another 1.

Whenever you cast a spell that deals fire damage, you can cause flames to wreathe you until the end of your next turn. The flames don't harm you or your possessions, and they shed bright light out to 30 feet and dim light for an additional 30 feet. While the flames are present, any creature within 5 feet of you that hits you with a melee attack takes {@damage 1d4} fire damage.

feats.name: Flash Recall
entries: You've developed the ability to instantly recall an unprepared spell in moments of sudden necessity.

As a bonus action, you prepare a spell of 1st level or higher from your spellbook (if you're a {@class wizard}) or from your class spell list (if you're not a {@class wizard}). This spell must be of a level for which you have spell slots, and it replaces another spell of an equal or higher level that you had previously prepared.
Once you use this feat to recall a spell, you can't do so again until you complete a {@quickref resting|PHB|2|0|short or long rest}.

entries.name: Rules Tip: Prepared Spells
entries: The Flash Recall feat requires you to be a spellcaster who prepares spells. This includes classes such as {@class cleric||clerics}, {@class druid||druids}, and {@class paladin||paladins}, who prepare spells each day from their class list, and {@class wizard||wizards}, who prepare spells from a spellbook. Classes such as {@class bard||bards} and {@class sorcerer||sorcerers}, who inherently know their spells rather than preparing them, can't benefit from this feat.
entries_es: La hazaña Flash Recall requiere que seas una máquina de hechizos que prepara hechizos. Esto incluye clases como {@class cleric||clerics}, {@class druid||druids}, y {@class paladin||paladins}, que preparan hechizos cada día de su lista de clases, y {@class wizard||wizards}, que preparan hechizos de un libro de hechizos. Clases como {@class bard||bards} y {@class sorcerer||sorcerers}, que conocen inherentemente sus hechizos en lugar de prepararlos, no pueden beneficiarse de esta hazaña.
Has desarrollado la capacidad de recordar instantáneamente un hechizo sin preparación en momentos de necesidad repentina.

Como acción de bonificación, usted prepara un hechizo de primer nivel o superior de su libro de hechizos (si usted es un {@class wizard}) o de su lista de hechizos de clase (si usted no es un {@class wizard}). Este hechizo debe ser de un nivel para el cual usted tiene ranuras de hechizo, y reemplaza otro hechizo de un nivel igual o superior que usted había preparado anteriormente.
Una vez que usas esta hazaña para recordar un hechizo, no puedes hacerlo de nuevo hasta que completes un {@quickref resting|PHB|2|0|short or long rest}.

feats.name: Fury of the Frost Giant

feat: strike of the giants|BGG|strike of the giants (frost strike)

entries: You've manifested the icy might emblematic of frost giants, granting you the following benefits:

items.name: Born of Ice
entries: You have resistance to cold damage.
entries_es: Tienes resistencia al daño frío.

items.name: Frigid Retaliation
entries: Immediately after a creature you can see within 30 feet of you hits you with an attack roll and deals damage, you can use your reaction to retaliate with a conjured blast of ice. The creature must make a Constitution saving throw (DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + the modifier of the ability increased by this feat). On a failed save, the creature takes cold damage equal to {@damage 1d8} + your proficiency bonus, and its speed is reduced to 0 until the end of its next turn. You can use this reaction a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
entries_es: Inmediatamente después de que una criatura que puedes ver a menos de 30 pies de ti te golpea con un tirada de ataque y te daña, puedes usar tu reacción para tomar represalias con una explosión de hielo conjurada. La criatura debe hacer una tirada de salvación de Constitución (DC es igual a 8 + su prima de competencia + el modificador de la capacidad aumentada por esta hazaña). En un salvación fallido, la criatura toma daño frío igual a {@damage 1d8} + su bonificación de competencia, y su velocidad se reduce a 0 hasta el final de su próximo turno. Usted puede utilizar esta reacción un número de veces igual a su bonificación de competencia, y usted recupera todos los usos gastados cuando termina un descanso largo.

entries: You've manifested some of the power of chromatic dragons, granting you the following benefits:

items.name: Chromatic Infusion
entries: As a bonus action, you can touch a {@filter simple or martial weapon|items|source=phb|category=basic|type=martial weapon;simple weapon} and infuse it with one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or poison. For the next minute, the weapon deals an extra {@damage 1d4} damage of the chosen type when it hits. After you use this bonus action, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.

Por el minuto siguiente, el arma trata un daño extra {@damage 1d4} del tipo elegido cuando golpea. entries: You've manifested some of the power of gem dragons, granting you the following benefits:

items.name: Telekinetic Reprisal
entries: When you take damage from a creature that is within 10 feet of you, you can use your reaction to emanate telekinetic energy. The creature that dealt damage to you must make a Strength saving throw (DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + the ability modifier of the score increased by this feat). On a failed save, the creature takes {@damage 2d8} force damage and is pushed up to 10 feet away from you. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't pushed. You can use this reaction a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
entries_es: Cuando usted toma el daño de una criatura que está a menos de 10 pies de usted, puede utilizar su reacción para emanar energía telequinética. La criatura que le dio daño debe hacer una tirada de salvación de fuerza (DC es igual a 8 + su bonificación de competencia + el modificador de habilidad de la puntuación aumentado por esta hazaña). En un fallido salvación, la criatura toma [[TAG0] fuerza daño y es empujado hasta 10 pies de distancia de usted. Con un salvación exitoso, la criatura toma la mitad del daño y no es empujada. Usted puede utilizar esta reacción un número de veces igual a su bonificación de competencia, y usted recupera todos los usos gastados cuando termina un descanso largo.

entries: You can manifest protective wings that can shield you or others. items: You have advantage on attack rolls against a creature you are grappling.

You can use your action to try to pin a creature {@condition grappled} by you. To do so, make another grapple check. If you succeed, you and the creature are both {@condition restrained} until the grapple ends.

entries_es.name: Attack Advantage
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against a creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by you.
entries_es: Usted tiene {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} sobre los rollos de ataque contra una criatura {@condition Grappled|XPHB} por usted.

entries_es.name: Fast Wrestler
entries: You don't have to spend extra movement to move a creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by you if the creature is your size or smaller.
entries_es: No tienes que gastar más movimiento para mover una criatura {@condition Grappled|XPHB} por ti si la criatura es tu tamaño o más pequeño.

feats.name: Great Weapon Fighting
entries: When you roll damage for an attack you make with a Melee weapon that you are holding with two hands, you can treat any 1 or 2 on a damage die as a 3. The weapon must have the Two-Handed or Versatile property to gain this benefit.
entries_es: Cuando usted hace daño por un ataque que usted hace con un arma Melee que usted está sosteniendo con dos manos, usted puede tratar cualquier 1 o 2 en un daño muere como un 3. El arma debe tener la propiedad Two-Handed o Versatile para ganar este beneficio.

feats.name: Great Weapon Master
entries: You've learned to put the weight of a weapon to your advantage, letting its momentum empower your strikes. You gain the following benefits:

items: On your turn, when you score a critical hit with a melee weapon or reduce a creature to 0 hit points with one, you can make one melee weapon attack as a bonus action.
Before you make a melee attack with a heavy weapon that you are proficient with, you can choose to take a -5 penalty to the attack roll. If the attack hits, you add +10 to the attack's damage.

entries_es: Ha aprendido a poner el peso de un arma a su ventaja, dejando que su impulso empodere sus huelgas. Usted gana los siguientes beneficios:

items: On your turn, when you score a critical hit with a melee weapon or reduce a creature to 0 hit points with one, you can make one melee weapon attack as a bonus action.
Before you make a melee attack with a heavy weapon that you are proficient with, you can choose to take a -5 penalty to the attack roll. If the attack hits, you add +10 to the attack's damage.

El daño adicional equivale a su {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}.

feats.name: Guile of the Cloud Giant

feat: strike of the giants|BGG|strike of the giants (cloud strike)

entries: You've manifested the confounding magic emblematic of cloud giants, granting you the following benefits:

items.name: Cloudy Escape
entries: When a creature you can see hits you with an attack roll, you can use your reaction to give yourself resistance to that attack's damage. You then teleport to an unoccupied space that you can see within 30 feet of yourself. You can use this reaction a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
entries_es: Cuando una criatura que puedes ver te golpea con un tirada de ataque, puedes usar tu reacción para darte resistencia al daño de ese ataque. Luego te teletransportas a un espacio inocupado que puedes ver a menos de 30 pies de ti mismo. Usted puede utilizar esta reacción un número de veces igual a su bonificación de competencia, y usted recupera todos los usos gastados cuando termina un descanso largo.

You ignore the loading property of firearms.
Being within 5 feet of a hostile creature doesn't impose disadvantage on your ranged attack rolls.

feats.name: Healer
entries: You are an able physician, allowing you to mend wounds quickly and get your allies back in the fight. You gain the following benefits:

items: When you use a {@item healer's kit|phb} to stabilize a dying creature, that creature also regains 1 hit point.

As an action, you can spend one use of a {@item healer's kit|phb} to tend to a creature and restore {@dice 1d6 + 4} hit points to it, plus additional hit points equal to the creature's maximum number of Hit Dice. The creature can't regain hit points from this feat again until it finishes a short or long rest.

entries_es: Eres un médico capaz, permitiéndote reparar heridas rápidamente y recuperar a tus aliados en la lucha. Usted gana los siguientes beneficios:

items: When you use a {@item healer's kit|phb} to stabilize a dying creature, that creature also regains 1 hit point.

That creature can expend one of its {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB}, and you then roll that die. The creature regains a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} equal to the roll plus your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}.

Esa criatura puede expulsar a uno de sus {@variantrule Hit Point Dice|XPHB}, y luego tirar que muere. La criatura recupera un número de {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} igual al rollo más su {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}.

entries: Whenever you roll a die to determine the number of {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} you restore with a spell or with this feat's Battle Medic benefit, you can reroll the die if it rolls a 1, and you must use the new roll.

entries: You have trained to master the use of heavy armor, gaining the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency with heavy armor.

entries: You can use your armor to deflect strikes that would kill others. You gain the following benefits:

items: While you are wearing heavy armor, bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage that you take from nonmagical attacks is reduced by 3.

feats.name: Infernal Constitution
entries: Fiendish blood runs strong in you, unlocking a resilience akin to that possessed by some fiends. You gain the following benefits:

items: You have resistance to cold and poison damage.
You have advantage on saving throws against being {@condition poisoned}.

items: You have resistance to cold and poison damage.

feats.name: Initiate of High Sorcery
entries: You've received training from magic-users affiliated with the Mages of High Sorcery.

Choose one of the three moons of Krynn to influence your magic: the black moon, Nuitari; the red moon, Lunitari; or the white moon, Solinari. You learn one cantrip of your choice from the wizard spell list and two 1st-level spells based on the moon you choose, as specified in the Lunar Spells table.

entries.caption: Lunar Spells
rows: Choose two from {@spell dissonant whispers}, {@spell false life}, {@spell hex}, and {@spell ray of sickness}
Choose two from {@spell color spray}, {@spell disguise self}, {@spell feather fall}, and {@spell longstrider}
Choose two from {@spell comprehend languages}, {@spell detect evil and good}, {@spell protection from evil and good}, and {@spell shield}

entries: You can cast each of the chosen 1st-level spells without a spell slot, and you must finish a long rest before you can cast them in this way again. You can also cast the spells using any spell slots you have.
Your spellcasting ability for this feat's spells is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (choose when you select this feat).
entries_es: Usted ha recibido entrenamiento de los usuarios mágicos afiliados a los Mages de Alta Sorcería.

Elige una de las tres lunas de Krynn para influir en tu magia: la luna negra, Nuitari; la luna roja, Lunitari; o la luna blanca, Solinari. Aprendes un cantrip de tu elección de la lista de hechizos magos y dos hechizos de primer nivel basados en la luna que elijas, como se especifica en la tabla Lunar Spells.

entries_es.caption: Lunar Spells
rows: Choose two from {@spell dissonant whispers}, {@spell false life}, {@spell hex}, and {@spell ray of sickness}
Choose two from {@spell color spray}, {@spell disguise self}, {@spell feather fall}, and {@spell longstrider}
Choose two from {@spell comprehend languages}, {@spell detect evil and good}, {@spell protection from evil and good}, and {@spell shield}

entries_es: Usted puede lanzar cada uno de los hechizos escogidos de primer nivel sin una ranura de hechizo, y debe terminar un largo descanso antes de que pueda echarlos de esta manera de nuevo. También puede lanzar los hechizos usando cualquier ranura de hechizo que tenga.
Su capacidad de spellcasting para los hechizos de esta hazaña es Inteligencia, Sabiduría o Charisma (elegir cuando se selecciona esta hazaña).

feats.name: Inspiring Leader
entries: You can spend 10 minutes inspiring your companions, shoring up their resolve to fight. When you do so, choose up to six friendly creatures (which can include yourself) within 30 feet of you who can see or hear you and who can understand you. Each creature can gain temporary hit points equal to your level + your Charisma modifier. A creature can't gain temporary hit points from this feat again until it has finished a short or long rest.
entries_es: Puedes pasar 10 minutos inspirando a tus compañeros, ahorcando su decisión de luchar. Cuando lo haces, elige hasta seis criaturas amigas (que pueden incluirte) a menos de 30 pies de ti que puedan verte o escucharte y que puedan entenderte. Cada criatura puede ganar puntos temporales iguales a su nivel + su modificador de Charisma. Una criatura no puede ganar puntos de éxito temporales de esta hazaña de nuevo hasta que haya terminado un breve o largo descanso.

feats.name: Inspiring Leader

entries.name: Bolstering Performance

When you do so, choose up to six allies (which can include yourself) within 30 feet of yourself who witness the performance. The chosen creatures each gain {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} equal to your character level plus the modifier of the ability you increased with this feat.

Cuando lo haces, elige hasta seis aliados (que pueden incluirte) a menos de 30 pies de ti mismo que presencian la actuación. Las criaturas elegidas cada ganancia {@variantrule Temporary Hit Points|XPHB} igual a su nivel de carácter más el modificador de la capacidad que aumentó con esta hazaña.

entries: As a bonus action, you can take a rock and make a magical attack with it. The attack is a ranged spell attack with a range of 60 feet that uses the ability score you increased with this feat as the spellcasting ability. On a hit, the rock deals {@damage 1d10} force damage, and the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + the spellcasting ability modifier) or have the prone condition. You can use this bonus action a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
entries_es: Como una acción de bonificación, usted puede tomar una roca y hacer un ataque mágico con ella. El ataque es un ataque de hechizos con una gama de 60 pies que utiliza la puntuación de habilidad que aumentó con esta hazaña como la habilidad de la spellcasting. En un éxito, las ofertas de roca {@damage 1d10} daño de la fuerza, y el objetivo debe tener éxito en una tirada de salvación de fuerza (DC es igual 8 + su bonificación de competencia + el modificador de habilidad de la spellcasting) o tener la condición de prono. Usted puede utilizar esta acción de bonificación un número de veces igual a su bonificación de competencia, y usted recupera todos los usos gastados cuando termina un descanso largo.

feats.name: Knight of the Crown

feat: squire of solamnia|dsotdq

entries: You are a Knight of Solamnia aligned with the Order of the Crown, a group that extols the virtues of cooperation, loyalty, and obedience. You excel in group combat and gain these benefits:

items.name: Commanding Rally
entries: As a bonus action, you can command one ally within 30 feet of yourself to attack. If that ally can see or hear you, they can immediately make one weapon attack as a reaction. If the attack hits, the ally can roll a {@dice d8} and add the number rolled as a bonus to the attack's damage roll. You can use this bonus action a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
entries_es: Como una acción de bonificación, usted puede ordenar un aliado dentro de 30 pies de usted mismo para atacar. Si ese aliado puede verte o escucharte, inmediatamente pueden hacer un ataque de arma como reacción. Si el ataque golpea, el aliado puede tirar un {@dice d8} y añadir el número rodado como un bono al tirada de daño del ataque. Usted puede utilizar esta acción de bonificación un número de veces igual a su bonificación de competencia, y usted recupera todos los usos gastados cuando termina un descanso largo.

entries.name: Membership in Knightly Orders
entries: Knights of Solamnia are only ever members of one of their organization's orders. In the course of their training, most knights begin as members of the Knights of the Crown and then move on to join other orders. Whether a character follows this path or another, they retain what they learned as a member of an order even if they join another. Characters can change what knightly order they're a part of, but they always have access to any Knight of Solamnia feats they've acquired.
entries_es: Caballeros de Solamnia son sólo miembros de una de las órdenes de su organización. En el curso de su formación, la mayoría de los caballeros comienzan como miembros de los Caballeros de la Corona y luego avanzan para unirse a otras órdenes. Si un personaje sigue este camino u otro, conservan lo que aprendieron como miembro de un orden incluso si se unen a otro. Los personajes pueden cambiar de qué orden caballeroso son parte, pero siempre tienen acceso a cualquier hazaña de Caballero de Solamnia que hayan adquirido.

entries: You are a Knight of Solamnia aligned with the Order of the Sword, a group devoted to heroism and courage. Bravery steels your spirit, granting you these benefits:

entries: Once per turn, when you hit a creature with a weapon attack roll, you can attempt to frighten that target. On a failed save, the target is {@condition frightened} of you until the end of your next turn. On a successful save, the target has disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn. You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
entries_es: Una vez por turno, cuando golpeas a una criatura con un tirada de ataque de armas, puedes intentar asustar a ese objetivo. En un salvación fallido, el objetivo es {@condition frightened} de ustedes hasta el final de su próximo turno. En un salvación exitoso, el objetivo tiene desventaja en el próximo lanzamiento de ataque que hace antes del final de su próximo turno. Usted puede utilizar este beneficio un número de veces igual a su prima de competencia, y usted recupera todos los usos gastados cuando usted termina un descanso largo.

feat: lords' alliance agent|frhof

entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Standard Bearer
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, choose up to three creatures within 60 feet of yourself that can see you. Each target can immediately take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to right itself and end the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition, provided its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} isn't 0. Additionally, you bolster the targets' resolve, which lasts for 1 minute or until you have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition. While bolstered, a target can't be possessed or gain the {@condition Charmed|XPHB} or {@condition Frightened|XPHB} condition; if a target is already possessed, {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, or {@condition Frightened|XPHB}, the target has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on any new saving throw against the relevant effect.
Once you use this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

Además, refuerza la resolución de los objetivos, que dura 1 minuto o hasta que tenga la condición {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}. Mientras se refuerza, un objetivo no puede ser poseído o ganar la condición {@condition Charmed|XPHB} o [[TAG6]; si un objetivo ya está poseído, {@condition Charmed|XPHB}, o [[TAG6], el objetivo tiene {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} en cualquier nuevo tirada de salvación contra el efecto relevante.

feats.name: Lucky
entries: You have inexplicable luck that seems to kick in at just the right moment.

You have 3 luck points. Whenever you make an attack roll, an ability check, or a saving throw, you can spend one luck point to roll an additional {@dice d20}. You can choose to spend one of your luck points after you roll the die, but before the outcome is determined. You choose which of the {@dice d20}s is used for the attack roll, ability check, or saving throw.

You can also spend one luck point when an attack roll is made against you. Roll a {@dice d20}, and then choose whether the attack uses the attacker's roll or yours. If more than one creature spends a luck point to influence the outcome of a roll, the points cancel each other out; no additional dice are rolled.
You regain your expended luck points when you finish a long rest.
entries_es: Tienes una suerte inexplicable que parece empezar en el momento adecuado.

Tienes 3 puntos de suerte. Cada vez que haces un tirada de ataque, un cheque de habilidad, o una tirada de salvación, puedes pasar un punto de suerte para tirar un adicional {@dice d20}. Puedes elegir gastar uno de tus puntos de suerte después de tirar la muerte, pero antes de que el resultado sea determinado. Usted elige cuál de los {@dice d20}s se utiliza para el tirada de ataque, tirada de habilidad, o tirada de salvación.

También puede pasar un punto de suerte cuando se hace un tirada de ataque contra usted. Roll a {@dice d20}, y luego elegir si el ataque utiliza el tirada del atacante o el suyo. Si más de una criatura gasta un punto de suerte para influir en el resultado de un rollo, los puntos se cancelan entre sí; no hay dados adicionales.
Recuperas tus puntos de suerte gastados cuando terminas un largo descanso.

entries_es: Cuando usted roda un [[TAG0] para un {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}, usted puede pasar 1 Punto de Suerte para darse a sí mismo {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} en el rollo.

entries_es.name: Disadvantage
entries: When a creature rolls a {@dice d20} for an attack roll against you, you can spend 1 Luck Point to impose {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on that roll.
entries_es: Cuando una criatura roda un {@dice d20} para un tirada de ataque contra usted, usted puede pasar 1 Punto de Suerte para imponer {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} en ese rollo.

feats.name: Mage Slayer
entries: You have practiced techniques useful in melee combat against spellcasters, gaining the following benefits:

items: When a creature within 5 feet of you casts a spell, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against that creature.
When you damage a creature that is {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell, that creature has disadvantage on the saving throw it makes to maintain its {@status concentration}.
You have advantage on saving throws against spells cast by creatures within 5 feet of you.

entries_es: Usted ha practicado técnicas útiles en el combate contra las spellcastings, ganando los siguientes beneficios:

items: When a creature within 5 feet of you casts a spell, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against that creature.
When you damage a creature that is {@status concentration||concentrating} on a spell, that creature has disadvantage on the saving throw it makes to maintain its {@status concentration}.
You have advantage on saving throws against spells cast by creatures within 5 feet of you.
