entries.name: Guarded Mind
entries: If you fail an Intelligence, a Wisdom, or a Charisma saving throw, you can cause yourself to succeed instead. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

feats.name: Magic Initiate
entries: Choose a class: {@filter bard|spells|level=0;1|class=bard}, {@filter cleric|spells|level=0;1|class=cleric}, {@filter druid|spells|level=0;1|class=druid}, {@filter sorcerer|spells|level=0;1|class=sorcerer}, {@filter warlock|spells|level=0;1|class=warlock}, or {@filter wizard|spells|level=0;1|class=wizard}. You learn two cantrips of your choice from that class's spell list.

In addition, choose one 1st-level spell to learn from that same list. Using this feat, you can cast the spell once at its lowest level, and you must finish a long rest before you can cast it in this way again.

Your spellcasting ability for these spells depends on the class you chose: Charisma for {@filter bard|spells|level=0;1|class=bard}, {@filter sorcerer|spells|level=0;1|class=sorcerer}, or {@filter warlock|spells|level=0;1|class=warlock}; Wisdom for {@filter cleric|spells|level=0;1|class=cleric} or {@filter druid|spells|level=0;1|class=druid}; or Intelligence for {@filter wizard|spells|level=0;1|class=wizard}.
entries_es: Elige una clase: {@filter bard|spells|level=0;1|class=bard}, {@filter cleric|spells|level=0;1|class=cleric}, {@filter druid|spells|level=0;1|class=druid}], {@filter sorcerer|spells|level=0;1|class=sorcerer}, {@filter warlock|spells|level=0;1|class=warlock}, o {@filter wizard|spells|level=0;1|class=wizard}. Aprendes dos cantrips de tu elección de la lista de hechizos de esa clase.

Además, elija un hechizo de primer nivel para aprender de esa misma lista. Usando esta hazaña, puedes lanzar el hechizo una vez a su nivel más bajo, y debes terminar un largo descanso antes de que puedas lanzarlo de esta manera de nuevo.

Su capacidad de spellcasting para estos hechizos depende de la clase que elegiste: Charisma for [TAG0]], {@filter sorcerer|spells|level=0;1|class=sorcerer}, o {@filter warlock|spells|level=0;1|class=warlock}; Sabiduría para [ [TAG3]]] o {@filter druid|spells|level=0;1|class=druid}]; o Inteligencia para {@filter wizard|spells|level=0;1|class=wizard}.

entries.name: Level 1 Spell

You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have.

feats.name: Martial Adept
entries: You have martial training that allows you to perform special combat maneuvers. You gain the following benefits:

items: You learn two {@filter maneuvers|optionalfeatures|feature type=MV:B} of your choice from among those available to the {@class fighter|phb|Battle Master|Battle Master|phb|2-0} archetype in the fighter class. If a maneuver you use requires your target to make a saving throw to resist the maneuver's effects, the saving throw DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength or Destreza modifier (your choice).

You gain one superiority die, which is a {@dice d6} (this die is added to any superiority dice you have from another source). This die is used to fuel your maneuvers. A superiority die is expended when you use it. You regain your expended superiority dice when you finish a short or long rest.

entries_es: Usted tiene entrenamiento marcial que le permite realizar maniobras especiales de combate. Usted gana los siguientes beneficios:

items: You learn two {@filter maneuvers|optionalfeatures|feature type=MV:B} of your choice from among those available to the {@class fighter|phb|Battle Master|Battle Master|phb|2-0} archetype in the fighter class. If a maneuver you use requires your target to make a saving throw to resist the maneuver's effects, the saving throw DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength or Destreza modifier (your choice).

You gain one superiority die, which is a {@dice d6} (this die is added to any superiority dice you have from another source). This die is used to fuel your maneuvers. A superiority die is expended when you use it. You regain your expended superiority dice when you finish a short or long rest.

feats.name: Medium Armor Master
entries: You have practiced moving in medium armor to gain the following benefits:

items: Wearing medium armor doesn't impose disadvantage on your Destreza ({@skill Stealth}) checks.
When you wear medium armor, you can add 3, rather than 2, to your AC if you have a Destreza of 16 or higher.

feats.name: Metamagic Adept
entries: You've learned how to exert your will on your spells to alter how they function:

items: You learn two {@filter Metamagic|optionalfeatures|Feature Type=MM} options of your choice from the sorcerer class. You can use only one Metamagic option on a spell when you cast it, unless the option says otherwise. Whenever you reach a level that grants the Ability Score Improvement feature, you can replace one of these Metamagic options with another one from the sorcerer class.

You gain 2 sorcery points to spend on Metamagic (these points are added to any sorcery points you have from another source but can be used only on Metamagic). You regain all spent sorcery points when you finish a long rest.

entries_es: Has aprendido a ejercer tu voluntad en tus hechizos para alterar cómo funcionan:

You can use only one Metamagic option on a spell when you cast it, unless the option says otherwise. Whenever you reach a level that grants the Ability Score Improvement feature, you can replace one of these Metamagic options with another one from the sorcerer class.

You gain 2 sorcery points to spend on Metamagic (these points are added to any sorcery points you have from another source but can be used only on Metamagic). You regain all spent sorcery points when you finish a long rest.

When you use the {@action Dash} action, {@quickref difficult terrain||3} doesn't cost you extra movement on that turn.
When you make a melee attack against a creature, you don't provoke opportunity attacks from that creature for the rest of the turn, whether you hit or not.

feats.name: Mounted Combatant
entries: You are a dangerous foe to face while {@book mounted|PHB|9|Mounted Combat}. While you are mounted and aren't {@condition incapacitated}, you gain the following benefits:

items: You have advantage on melee attack rolls against any unmounted creature that is smaller than your mount.
You can force an attack targeted at your mount to target you instead.

If your mount is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Destreza saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

items: You have advantage on melee attack rolls against any unmounted creature that is smaller than your mount.
You can force an attack targeted at your mount to target you instead.

If your mount is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Destreza saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw, and only half damage if it fails.

entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Mounted Strike
entries: While {@book mounted|XPHB|1|Mounted Combat}, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against any unmounted creature within 5 feet of your mount that is at least one size smaller than the mount.
entries_es: Mientras {@book mounted|XPHB|1|Mounted Combat}, usted tiene {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} en rollos de ataque contra cualquier criatura no montada dentro de 5 pies de su monte que es al menos un tamaño menor que el montaje.

entries.name: Leap Aside
entries: If your mount is subjected to an effect that allows it to make a Destreza saving throw to take only half damage, it instead takes no damage if it succeeds on the saving throw and only half damage if it fails. For your mount to gain this benefit, you must be riding it, and neither of you can have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

Para que su montaje obtenga este beneficio, usted debe estar montando, y ninguno de ustedes puede tener la condición {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}.

entries_es.name: Veer

feats.name: Mystic Conflux
entries: You possess an intuitive understanding of the way magic ebbs and flows within enchanted items. Such items attune easily to you, and you are able to sound out their secrets. You gain the following benefits:

items: You can attune to up to four magic items at once.
You can cast the {@spell identify} spell without expending a spell slot or material components. You must finish a {@quickref resting|PHB|2|0|long rest} before you can do so again.

entries_es: Usted posee una comprensión intuitiva de la forma en que la magia abre y fluye dentro de objetos encantados. Tales artículos se ajustan fácilmente a usted, y usted es capaz de sonar sus secretos. Usted gana los siguientes beneficios:

items: You can attune to up to four magic items at once.
You can cast the {@spell identify} spell without expending a spell slot or material components. You must finish a {@quickref resting|PHB|2|0|long rest} before you can do so again.

entries.name: Mythal Ward
entries: If a spell attack hits you or you fail a saving throw against a spell, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to roll on the Mythal-Touched {@action Magic|XPHB} table to create a magical effect. If an effect requires a saving throw, the DC equals 8 plus the modifier of the ability increased by this feat and your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}.
You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

entries.caption: Mythal-Touched Magic
rows: You and each creature within 15 feet of you make a Destreza saving throw, taking Force damage equal to {@dice 1d8} times the level of the triggering spell on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
You and the triggering spell's caster form a telepathic link for 1 hour.
Gravity is reversed in a 15-foot-radius, 60-foot-tall {@variantrule Cylinder [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cylinder} centered on you for 1 minute, per the {@spell Reverse Gravity|XPHB} spell.
You and the triggering spell's caster each make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the creature has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition until the end of its next turn.
You gain a +2 bonus to AC for 1 minute, potentially turning the triggering spell into a miss if it was a spell attack.

Any flammable, nonmagical object within 10 feet of the triggering spell's caster that isn't being worn or carried by another creature bursts into flame, takes {@damage 1d4} Fire damage, and is burning.

The triggering spell dissipates with no effect, and the action, {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, or {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} used to cast it is wasted. If that spell was cast with a spell slot, the slot isn't expended.

entries_es: Si un ataque de hechizos te golpea o fallas una tirada de salvación contra un hechizo, puedes tomar un {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} para tirar en la mesa de Mythal-Touched {@action Magic|XPHB} para crear un efecto mágico. Puede utilizar este beneficio varias veces igual a su {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}, y recuperar todos los usos gastados cuando termine un {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

items: When you hit with an attack using a {@filter simple or martial weapon|items|source=phb|category=basic|type=martial weapon;simple weapon}, you can roll one of the weapon's damage dice an additional time and add it as extra damage of the weapon's damage type. Immediately after you use your Relentless Endurance trait, you can use your reaction to make one weapon attack.

feats.name: Outlands Envoy

feat: scion of the outer planes|sato|scion of the outer planes (the outlands)

entries: You have spent significant time in Sigil or the Outlands, the crossroads of the multiverse. Being steeped in converging planar energies grants you these benefits:

items.name: Crossroads Emissary
entries: You learn the {@spell misty step} and {@spell tongues} spells. You can cast each spell once using this feat without a spell slot, and you must finish a long rest before you can cast that spell in this way again. When you cast {@spell tongues} using this feat, you require no material components. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spells' spellcasting ability is the one chosen when you gained the Scion of the Outer Planes feat.

feats.name: Planar Wanderer

feat: scion of the outer planes|sato

entries: You can draw on the forces of the multiverse to survive cosmic extremes and to traverse its infinite realms, granting you these benefits:

items.name: Planar Adaptation
entries: When you finish a long rest, you gain resistance to either acid, cold, or fire damage (your choice) until you finish your next long rest.
entries_es: Cuando terminas un largo descanso, ganas resistencia al ácido, frío o daño al fuego (su elección) hasta que termines tu próximo descanso largo.

items.name: Portal Cracker
entries: Your experience with portals allows you to open them without a portal key. As an action, you can concentrate on a portal you're aware of that is within 5 feet of yourself and make a {@dc 20} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check. On a failed check, you take {@damage 3d8} psychic damage and can't use this benefit on that portal again until you finish a long rest. On a successful check, you can force the portal open or closed for 1 hour. For that duration, the portal doesn't respond to its portal key unless a creature employing the key succeeds on a {@dc 20} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check as an action.
entries_es: Su experiencia con portales le permite abrirlos sin una llave de portal. Como acción, usted puede concentrarse en un portal que usted está consciente de que está a menos de 5 pies de usted y hacer un {@dc 20} Inteligencia ({@skill Arcana}) cheque. En un cheque fallido, usted toma {@damage 3d8} daño psíquico y no puede utilizar este beneficio en ese portal de nuevo hasta que termine un descanso largo. En un cheque exitoso, puede forzar el portal abierto o cerrado durante 1 hora. Para esa duración, el portal no responde a su clave del portal a menos que una criatura que emplee la clave tenga éxito en un {@dc 20} Inteligencia ({@skill Arcana}) cheque como una acción.

items.name: Portal Sense
entries: You know the direction to the last planar portal you used while you and the portal are on the same plane of existence. Moreover, as an action, you can detect the location of any portals within 30 feet of you that aren't behind {@quickref Cover||3||total cover}. Once you detect a portal with this action, you can't use the action again until you finish a long rest.
entries_es: Sabes la dirección al último portal planar que usaste mientras tú y el portal están en el mismo plano de la existencia. Además, como acción, puede detectar la ubicación de cualquier portal dentro de 30 pies de usted que no están detrás {@quickref Cover||3||total cover}. Una vez que detectas un portal con esta acción, no puedes usar la acción de nuevo hasta que termines un largo descanso.

feats.name: Poisoner
entries: You can prepare and deliver deadly poisons, granting you the following benefits:

items: When you make a damage roll that deals poison damage, it ignores resistance to poison damage.
You can apply poison to a weapon or piece of ammunition as a bonus action, instead of an action.

You gain proficiency with the {@item poisoner's kit|phb} if you don't already have it. With one hour of work using a {@item poisoner's kit|phb} and expending 50 gp worth of materials, you can create a number of doses of potent poison equal to your proficiency bonus. Once applied to a weapon or piece of ammunition, the poison retains its potency for 1 minute or until you hit with the weapon or ammunition. When a creature takes damage from the coated weapon or ammunition, that creature must succeed on a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw or take {@damage 2d8} poison damage and become {@condition poisoned} until the end of your next turn.

feats.name: Quicksmithing
entries: You have mastered the art of on-the-fly invention, improvement, and jury-rigging. You can use your talents to create immediate, short-term magical effects similar to spells, given time and an adequate supply of aether.

When you choose this feat, you master two magical effects, each of which recreates the effect of a 1st-level spell that has the ritual tag. These spells can come from any class list, but Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for them.

If you come across a schematic geared toward quicksmithing or study with another quicksmith, you might be able to add another spell to the effects you have mastered. The spell's level can be no higher than half your level (rounded up), and it must have the ritual tag. The process of mastering the spell takes 2 hours per level of the spell, and costs 50 gp per level. The cost represents aether you use as you experiment with the spell effect to master it.

In addition, you have proficiency with {@item artisan's tools|PHB} (quicksmith's tools). Using those tools, you can spend 1 hour and 10 gp worth of materials to construct a Tiny clockwork device (AC 5, 1 hp). The device ceases to function after 24 hours unless you spend 1 hour repairing it to keep it functioning. You can use your action to dismantle the device, at which point you can reclaim the materials used to create it. You can have up to three such devices active at a time.
When you create a device, choose one of the following options:

entries.name: Clockwork Toy
entries: This toy is a clockwork animal, monster, or person, such as a frog, mouse, bird, dragon, or soldier. When placed on the ground, the toy moves 5 feet across the ground on each of your turns in a random direction. It makes noises as appropriate to the creature it represents.

feats.name: Ritual Caster
entries: You have learned a number of spells that you can cast as rituals. These spells are written in a ritual book, which you must have in hand while casting one of them.

When you choose this feat, you acquire a ritual book holding two 1st-level spells of your choice. Choose one of the following classes: {@filter bard|spells|level=1|class=bard|components & miscellaneous=ritual}, {@filter cleric|spells|level=1|class=cleric|components & miscellaneous=ritual}, {@filter druid|spells|level=1|class=druid|components & miscellaneous=ritual}, {@filter sorcerer|spells|level=1|class=sorcerer|components & miscellaneous=ritual}, {@filter warlock|spells|level=1|class=warlock|components & miscellaneous=ritual}, or {@filter wizard|spells|level=1|class=wizard|components & miscellaneous=ritual}. You must choose your spells from that class's spell list, and the spells you choose must have the ritual tag. The class you choose also determines your spellcasting ability for these spells: Charisma for bard, sorcerer, or warlock; Wisdom for cleric or druid; or Intelligence for wizard.

If you come across a spell in written form, such as a magical {@item spell scroll} or a wizard's spellbook, you might be able to add it to your ritual book. The spell must be on the spell list for the class you chose, the spell's level can be no higher than half your level (rounded up), and it must have the ritual tag. The process of copying the spell into your ritual book takes 2 hours per level of the spell, and costs 50 gp per level. The cost represents material components you expend as you experiment with the spell to master it, as well as the fine inks you need to record it.
entries_es: Has aprendido una serie de hechizos que puedes lanzar como rituales. Estos hechizos están escritos en un libro ritual, que usted debe tener en la mano al lanzar uno de ellos.

Cuando eliges esta hazaña, adquieres un libro ritual que contiene dos hechizos de primer nivel de tu elección. Elige una de las siguientes clases: {@filter bard|spells|level=1|class=bard|components & miscellaneous=ritual}, {@filter cleric|spells|level=1|class=cleric|components & miscellaneous=ritual}, {@filter druid|spells|level=1|class=druid|components & miscellaneous=ritual}], {@filter sorcerer|spells|level=1|class=sorcerer|components & miscellaneous=ritual}, {@filter warlock|spells|level=1|class=warlock|components & miscellaneous=ritual}, o {@filter wizard|spells|level=1|class=wizard|components & miscellaneous=ritual}. Debes elegir tus hechizos de la lista de hechizos de esa clase, y los hechizos que elijas deben tener la etiqueta ritual. La clase que usted elige también determina su habilidad de spellcasting para estos hechizos: Charisma para desnudo, hechicero, o candado; Sabiduría para clérigo o druido; o Inteligencia para mago.

Si encuentras un hechizo en forma escrita, como un libro mágico {@item spell scroll} o un libro de hechizos del mago, puedes añadirlo a tu libro ritual. El hechizo debe estar en la lista de hechizos para la clase que elegiste, el nivel del hechizo no puede ser superior a la mitad de tu nivel (redondeado), y debe tener la etiqueta ritual. El proceso de copiar el hechizo en su libro ritual lleva 2 horas por nivel del hechizo, y cuesta 50 gp por nivel. El costo representa los componentes materiales que gastas mientras experimentas con el hechizo para dominarlo, así como las tintas finas que necesitas grabarlo.

feats.name: Ritual Caster
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Ritual Spells
entries: Choose a number of level 1 spells equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} that have the {@filter Ritual tag|spells|level=1|components & miscellaneous=ritual}. You always have those spells prepared, and you can cast them with any spell slots you have. The spells' spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat. Whenever your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} increases thereafter, you can add an additional level 1 spell with the {@variantrule Ritual|XPHB} tag to the spells always prepared with this feature.
entries_es: Elija un número de hechizos de nivel 1 iguales a su {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} que tienen el {@filter Ritual tag|spells|level=1|components & miscellaneous=ritual}. Siempre tienes esos hechizos preparados, y puedes lanzarlos con cualquier ranura de hechizo que tengas. La habilidad de los hechizos es la habilidad aumentada por esta hazaña. Cada vez que su {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} aumenta posteriormente, puede agregar un hechizo de nivel 1 adicional con la etiqueta {@variantrule Ritual|XPHB} a los hechizos siempre preparados con esta característica.

entries.name: Quick Ritual
entries: With this benefit, you can cast a {@variantrule Ritual|XPHB} spell that you have prepared using its regular casting time rather than the extended time for a {@variantrule Ritual|XPHB}. Doing so doesn't require a spell slot. Once you cast the spell in this way, you can't use this benefit again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
entries_es: Con este beneficio, usted puede lanzar un [[TAG0] hechizo que usted ha preparado utilizando su tiempo de casting regular en lugar del tiempo extendido para un {@variantrule Ritual|XPHB}. Hacerlo no requiere un hechizo. Una vez que usted lanzó el hechizo de esta manera, no puede utilizar este beneficio de nuevo hasta que termine un {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.
Ganas los siguientes beneficios.

feats.name: Rune Shaper
entries: You've studied the magic of Giant runes, granting you the following benefits:

items.name: Comprehend Languages
entries: You learn the {@spell comprehend languages} spell. You can cast this spell without expending a spell slot, and you must finish a long rest before you can cast it in this way again. You can also cast this spell using any spell slots you have.
entries_es: Aprendes el hechizo {@spell comprehend languages}. Usted puede lanzar este hechizo sin gastar una ranura de hechizo, y debe terminar un largo descanso antes de que usted pueda echarlo de esta manera de nuevo. También puede lanzar este hechizo usando cualquier ranura de hechizo que tenga.

items.name: Rune Magic
entries: You know a number of runes equal to half your proficiency bonus (rounded down), chosen from the Rune Spells table. Whenever you finish a long rest, you can inscribe each rune you know onto one nonmagical weapon, armor, piece of clothing, or other object you touch. You temporarily learn the 1st-level spells that correspond to the runes you inscribed, as specified on the Rune Spells table, and you know those spells until you finish a long rest, when the runes fade. While you are wearing or carrying any rune-marked object, you can cast the spells associated with those runes using any spell slots you have.

You can also invoke a rune inscribed on an object you are wearing or carrying and cast its associated spell without expending a spell slot or using material components. Once you cast the spell in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest. Your spellcasting ability for this feat is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (choose when you select this feat).
Each time you gain a level, you can replace one of the runes you know with another one from the Rune Spells table.
entries_es: Conoces una serie de runas iguales a la mitad de tu bonificación de competencia (redondeada), elegida de la mesa Rune Spells. Cada vez que terminas un largo descanso, puedes inscribir cada runa que conoces sobre un arma, armadura, pedazo de ropa u otro objeto que toques. Usted aprende temporalmente los hechizos de primer nivel que corresponden a las runas que inscribió, como se especifica en la tabla Rune Spells, y conoce esos hechizos hasta que termine un descanso largo, cuando las runas se desvanecen. Mientras usted está usando o llevando cualquier objeto marcado por rune, usted puede lanzar los hechizos asociados con esas runas usando cualquier ranura de hechizo que usted tiene.

También puede invocar una runa inscrita en un objeto que está usando o llevando y lanzar su hechizo asociado sin gastar una ranura de hechizo o utilizar componentes materiales. Una vez que lanzas el hechizo de esta manera, no puedes hacerlo de nuevo hasta que termines un largo descanso. Su habilidad de spellcasting para esta hazaña es Inteligencia, Sabiduría o Charisma (elegir esta hazaña).
Cada vez que ganas un nivel, puedes reemplazar una de las runas que conoces con otra de la mesa Rune Spells.

feats.name: Savage Attacker
entries: Once per turn when you roll damage for a melee weapon attack, you can reroll the weapon's damage dice and use either total.
entries_es: Una vez por turno cuando te dañas por un ataque de arma melee, puedes rerollar los dados de daño del arma y usar total.

feats.name: Savage Attacker
entries: You've trained to deal particularly damaging strikes. Once per turn when you hit a target with a weapon, you can roll the weapon's damage dice twice and use either roll against the target.
entries_es: Has entrenado para hacer huelgas particularmente dañinas. Una vez por turno cuando golpeas a un blanco con un arma, puedes tirar los dados de daño del arma dos veces y usar el rollo contra el objetivo.

feats.name: Scion of the Outer Planes
entries: Your connection to an Outer Plane infuses you with the energy there. Choose a type of plane listed in the Planar Infusion table. Your choice gives you resistance to a damage type and the ability to cast a cantrip, as specified in the table. You can cast this cantrip without material components, and your spellcasting ability for it is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (choose when you select this feat).
entries_es: Su conexión con un Plano Exterior le infunde con la energía allí. Elija un tipo de avión listado en la tabla de Infusión Planar. Su elección le da resistencia a un tipo de daño y la capacidad de lanzar un cantrip, como se especifica en la tabla. Usted puede lanzar este cantrip sin componentes materiales, y su capacidad de spellcasting para él es Inteligencia, Sabiduría o Charisma (elegir cuando se selecciona esta hazaña).

feats.name: Second Chance
entries: Fortune favors you when someone tries to strike you. You gain the following benefits:

items: When a creature you can see hits you with an attack roll, you can use your reaction to force that creature to reroll. Once you use this ability, you can't use it again until you roll initiative at the start of combat or until you finish a short or long rest.

entries_es: La fortuna te favorece cuando alguien intenta golpearte. Usted gana los siguientes beneficios:

items: When a creature you can see hits you with an attack roll, you can use your reaction to force that creature to reroll. Once you use this ability, you can't use it again until you roll initiative at the start of combat or until you finish a short or long rest.

feats.name: Sentinel
entries: You have mastered techniques to take advantage of every drop in any enemy's guard, gaining the following benefits:

items: When you hit a creature with an opportunity attack, the creature's speed becomes 0 for the rest of the turn.
Creatures provoke opportunity attacks from you even if they take the {@action Disengage} action before leaving your reach.

When a creature within 5 feet of you makes an attack against a target other than you (and that target doesn't have this feat), you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against the attacking creature.

entries_es: Usted ha dominado técnicas para aprovechar cada gota en la guardia de cualquier enemigo, ganando los siguientes beneficios:

items: When you hit a creature with an opportunity attack, the creature's speed becomes 0 for the rest of the turn.
Creatures provoke opportunity attacks from you even if they take the {@action Disengage} action before leaving your reach.

When a creature within 5 feet of you makes an attack against a target other than you (and that target doesn't have this feat), you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against the attacking creature.

feats.name: Sentinel
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Guardian
entries: Immediately after a creature within 5 feet of you takes the {@action Disengage|XPHB} action or hits a target other than you with an attack, you can make an {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} against that creature.
entries_es: Inmediatamente después de que una criatura a menos de 5 pies tome la acción {@action Disengage|XPHB} o golpee a un objetivo que no sea usted con un ataque, usted puede hacer un {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} contra esa criatura.

entries.name: Halt
entries: When you hit a creature with an {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB}, the creature's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} becomes 0 for the rest of the current turn.
entries_es: Cuando golpeas a una criatura con un {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB}, la criatura {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} se convierte en 0 para el resto del turno actual.
Ganas los siguientes beneficios.

entries_es: Cuando golpeas a una criatura con un {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB}, la criatura {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} se convierte en 0 para el resto del turno actual.

feats.name: Servo Crafting
entries: You are skilled in the creation of {@creature servo|psk|servos}—tiny constructs that function as personal assistants. You can cast the {@spell find familiar} spell as a ritual, creating a {@creature servo|psk} to serve as your familiar instead of an animal. A {@creature servo|psk}'s statistics appear in the "Artifact Creatures" section of this document. In every other way, a servo familiar functions as described in the {@spell find familiar} spell.
You can communicate telepathically with your servo familiar and perceive through its senses as long as you are on the same plane of existence. You can speak through your servo in your own voice.
Additionally, when you take the {@action Attack} action, you can forgo one of your own attacks to allow your servo familiar to make one attack of its own.
entries_es: Usted es hábil en la creación de {@creature servo|psk|servos}—construye que funcionan como asistentes personales. Usted puede lanzar el hechizo {@spell find familiar} como un ritual, creando un {@creature servo|psk} para servir como su familiar en lugar de un animal. Las estadísticas {@creature servo|psk} aparecen en la sección "Creaciones de artefactos" de este documento. De todas maneras, un servo funciones familiares como se describe en el [[TAG1] hechizo.
Puedes comunicarte telepáticamente con tu servo familiar y percibir a través de sus sentidos mientras estés en el mismo plano de la existencia. Puedes hablar a través de tu servo en tu propia voz.
Además, cuando usted toma la acción {@action Attack}, puede renunciar a uno de sus propios ataques para permitir que su servo familiarice para hacer un ataque propio.

feats.name: Shadow Touched
entries: Your exposure to the Shadowfell's magic has changed you, granting you the following benefits:

items: You learn the {@spell invisibility} spell and one {@filter 1st-level spell|spells|level=1|school=I;N} of your choice. The {@filter 1st-level spell|spells|level=1|school=I;N} must be from the illusion or necromancy school of magic. You can cast each of these spells without expending a spell slot. Once you cast either of these spells in this way, you can't cast that spell in this way again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spells' spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.

entries_es: Su exposición a la magia de la Sombra le ha cambiado, concediéndole los siguientes beneficios:

items: You learn the {@spell invisibility} spell and one {@filter 1st-level spell|spells|level=1|school=I;N} of your choice. Puedes lanzar cada uno de estos hechizos sin gastar una ranura de hechizo. Una vez que lanzas un hechizo de esta manera, no puedes volver a lanzar ese hechizo hasta que termines un {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. También puede lanzar estos hechizos usando ranuras de hechizo que tiene del nivel apropiado. La habilidad de los hechizos es la habilidad aumentada por esta hazaña.
Su exposición a la magia de la Sombra le otorga los siguientes beneficios.

You can cast each of these spells without expending a spell slot. Once you cast either spell in this way, you can't cast that spell in this way again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spells' spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.

feats.name: Sharpshooter
entries: You have mastered ranged weapons and can make shots that others find impossible. You gain the following benefits:

items: Attacking at long range doesn't impose disadvantage on your ranged weapon attack rolls.
Your ranged weapon attacks ignore {@quickref Cover||3||half cover} and {@quickref Cover||3||three-quarters cover}.
Before you make an attack with a ranged weapon that you are proficient with, you can choose to take a -5 penalty to the attack roll. If the attack hits, you add +10 to the attack's damage.

entries_es: Usted ha dominado armas variadas y puede hacer disparos que otros encuentran imposible. Usted gana los siguientes beneficios:

items: Attacking at long range doesn't impose disadvantage on your ranged weapon attack rolls.
Your ranged weapon attacks ignore {@quickref Cover||3||half cover} and {@quickref Cover||3||three-quarters cover}.
Before you make an attack with a ranged weapon that you are proficient with, you can choose to take a -5 penalty to the attack roll. If the attack hits, you add +10 to the attack's damage.

entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Bypass Cover
entries: Your ranged attacks with weapons ignore {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Half Cover} and {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Three-Quarters Cover}.
entries_es: Sus ataques con armas ignoran {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Half Cover} y {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Three-Quarters Cover}.

entries.name: Firing in Melee
entries: Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn't impose {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on your attack rolls with Ranged weapons.
entries_es: Estar a menos de 5 pies de un enemigo no impone {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} en sus rollos de ataque con armas Ranged.

entries.name: Long Shots
entries: Attacking at long range doesn't impose {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on your attack rolls with Ranged weapons.
entries_es: Atacar a largo plazo no impone {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} en sus rollos de ataque con armas Ranged.

feats.name: Shield Master
entries: You use shields not just for protection but also for offense. You gain the following benefits while you are wielding a {@item shield|phb}:

items: If you take the {@action Attack} action on your turn, you can use a bonus action to try to {@action shove} a creature within 5 feet of you with your shield.
If you aren't {@condition incapacitated}, you can add your shield's AC bonus to any Destreza saving throw you make against a spell or other harmful effect that targets only you.

If you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Destreza saving throw to take only half damage, you can use your reaction to take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw, interposing your shield between yourself and the source of the effect.

entries_es: Usas escudos no solo para protección sino también para ofender. Usted gana los siguientes beneficios mientras usted está wielding a {@item shield|phb}:

items: If you take the {@action Attack} action on your turn, you can use a bonus action to try to {@action shove} a creature within 5 feet of you with your shield.
If you aren't {@condition incapacitated}, you can add your shield's AC bonus to any Destreza saving throw you make against a spell or other harmful effect that targets only you.

If you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Destreza saving throw to take only half damage, you can use your reaction to take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw, interposing your shield between yourself and the source of the effect.

feats.name: Shield Master
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Shield Bash
entries: If you attack a creature within 5 feet of you as part of the {@action Attack|XPHB} action and hit with a Melee weapon, you can immediately bash the target with your {@item Shield|XPHB} if it's equipped, forcing the target to make a Strength saving throw ({@dc 8} plus your Strength modifier and {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}). On a failed save, you either push the target 5 feet from you or cause it to have the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition (your choice). You can use this benefit only once on each of your turns.
entries_es: Si atacas a una criatura a menos de 5 pies de ti como parte de la acción {@action Attack|XPHB} y golpeas con un arma Melee, puedes basar inmediatamente el objetivo con tu {@item Shield|XPHB} si está equipado, obligando al objetivo a hacer una tirada de salvación de fuerza ([TAG2]] más tu modificador de fuerza y {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}). En un salvación fallido, usted o empuja el objetivo 5 pies de usted o causar que tenga la condición {@condition Prone|XPHB} (su elección). Usted puede utilizar este beneficio sólo una vez en cada uno de sus turnos.

entries.name: Interpose Shield
entries: If you're subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Destreza saving throw to take only half damage, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw and are holding a {@item Shield|XPHB}.
entries_es: Si usted está sujeto a un efecto que le permite hacer una tirada de salvación de la Dexteridad para tomar sólo medio daño, usted puede tomar un {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} para no tomar ningún daño si usted tiene éxito en eltirada de salvación y están sosteniendo un {@item Shield|XPHB}.

entries_es.name: Shield Bash

entries: You've manifested the tempest magic emblematic of storm giants, granting you the following benefits:

items.name: Maelstrom Aura
entries: As a bonus action, you surround yourself with an aura of magical wind and lightning that extends 10 feet from you in every direction but not through {@quickref Cover||3||total cover}. The aura lasts until the start of your next turn or until you are incapacitated. While the aura is active, you have resistance to lightning and thunder damage. In addition, attack rolls against you have disadvantage, and whenever another creature starts its turn within the aura, you can force the creature to make a Strength saving throw (DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + the modifier of the ability increased by this feat). On a failed save, the creature's speed is halved until the start of its next turn. You can use this bonus action a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
entries_es: Como acción de bonificación, te rodeas con un aura de viento mágico y relámpago que se extiende a 10 pies de ti en cada dirección pero no a través [[TAG0]. feats.name: Spelldriver
entries: Through intense focus, training, and dedication, you've harnessed the techniques of rapid spellcasting.

When you use your bonus action to cast a spell of 1st level or higher, you can also use your action to cast another spell of 1st level or higher. However, if you cast two or more spells in a single turn, only one of them can be 3rd level or higher.

entries.name: Rules Tip: Casting Multiple Spells
entries: Normally, when you cast a spell as a bonus action, you can't use your action to also cast a spell that turn unless that spell is a cantrip—{@note see {@book PHB p202|PHB|10|Bonus Action}.} The Spelldriver feat removes that restriction, but the focus necessary to channel multiple spells in the same round still limits the overall power of those spells.
entries_es: Normalmente, cuando usted lanza un hechizo como una acción de bonificación, no puede utilizar su acción también para lanzar un hechizo que gire a menos que ese hechizo sea un cantrip—{@note see {@book PHB p202|PHB|10|Bonus Action}.} La hazaña de Spelldriver elimina esa restricción, pero el enfoque necesario para canalizar múltiples hechizos en la misma ronda todavía limita el poder general de esos hechizos.
A través del enfoque intenso, el entrenamiento y la dedicación, has aprovechado las técnicas de la spellcasting rápida.

Cuando usas tu acción de bonificación para lanzar un hechizo de primer nivel o superior, también puedes usar tu acción para lanzar otro hechizo de primer nivel o superior. Sin embargo, si usted lanza dos o más hechizos en un solo giro, sólo uno de ellos puede ser 3o nivel o superior.

You can use this benefit a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, but a use is expended only if the attack hits. You regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
entries_es: Una vez por turno, cuando haces un tirada de ataque de armas contra una criatura, puedes hacer que el tirada de ataque tenga ventaja. Si el ataque golpea, tirarás un {@dice d8} y agregas el número rodado como un bono al tirada de daño del ataque. Usted puede utilizar este beneficio un número de veces igual a su prima de competencia, pero un uso se gasta sólo si el ataque golpea. Recuperas todos los usos gastados cuando terminas un largo descanso.

entries.name: Membership in Knightly Orders
entries: Knights of Solamnia are only ever members of one of their organization's orders. In the course of their training, most knights begin as members of the Knights of the Crown and then move on to join other orders. Whether a character follows this path or another, they retain what they learned as a member of an order even if they join another. Characters can change what knightly order they're a part of, but they always have access to any Knight of Solamnia feats they've acquired.
entries_es: Caballeros de Solamnia son sólo miembros de una de las órdenes de su organización. En el curso de su formación, la mayoría de los caballeros comienzan como miembros de los Caballeros de la Corona y luego avanzan para unirse a otras órdenes. Si un personaje sigue este camino u otro, conservan lo que aprendieron como miembro de un orden incluso si se unen a otro. Los personajes pueden cambiar de qué orden caballeroso son parte, pero siempre tienen acceso a cualquier hazaña de Caballero de Solamnia que hayan adquirido.

feats.name: Street Justice
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Headlock
entries: Your allies have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on attack rolls against a creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by you.
entries_es: Sus aliados tienen {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} sobre los rollos de ataque contra una criatura {@condition Grappled|XPHB} por ustedes.

entries.name: Sturdy Knot

feats.name: Strike of the Giants
entries: You have absorbed primeval magic that gives you an echo of the might of giants. When you take this feat, choose one of the benefits listed below. Once per turn, when you hit a target with a melee weapon attack or a ranged weapon attack using a thrown weapon, you can imbue the attack with an additional effect depending on the benefit you chose:

entries.name: Cloud Strike
entries: The target takes an extra {@damage 1d4} thunder damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw, or you become invisible to it until the start of your next turn or until immediately after you make an attack roll or cast a spell.
entries_es: El objetivo toma un daño extra [[TAG0] del trueno. Si el objetivo es una criatura, debe tener éxito en una tirada de salvación de Sabiduría, o te vuelves invisible hasta el comienzo de tu próximo turno o hasta inmediatamente después de hacer un tirada de ataque o lanzar un hechizo.

entries.name: Fire Strike
entries: The target takes an extra {@damage 1d10} fire damage.
entries_es: El objetivo toma un daño extra {@damage 1d10}.

entries.name: Frost Strike
entries: The target takes an extra {@damage 1d6} cold damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw, or its speed is reduced to 0 until the start of your next turn.
entries_es: El objetivo toma un daño frío [[TAG0] extra. Si el objetivo es una criatura, debe tener éxito en una tirada de salvación de Constitución, o su velocidad se reduce a 0 hasta el comienzo de su próximo turno.

entries.name: Hill Strike
entries: The target takes an extra {@damage 1d6} damage of the weapon's type. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw or have the prone condition.
entries_es: El objetivo toma un daño extra [[TAG0] del tipo del arma. Si el objetivo es una criatura, debe tener éxito en una tirada de salvación de fuerza o tener la condición prone.

entries.name: Stone Strike
entries: The target takes an extra {@damage 1d6} force damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet from you in a straight line.
entries_es: El objetivo toma un daño adicional {@damage 1d6} fuerza. Si el objetivo es una criatura, debe tener éxito en una tirada de salvación de fuerza o ser empujado a 10 pies de usted en una línea recta.

entries.name: Storm Strike
entries: The target takes an extra {@damage 1d6} lightning damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw, or it has disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of your next turn.
The saving throw DC for these effects equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength or Constitution modifier.
You can use this feat a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a long rest.
entries_es: El objetivo toma un daño extra {@damage 1d6} relámpago. Si el objetivo es una criatura, debe tener éxito en una tirada de salvación de Constitución, o tiene desventaja en los rollos de ataque hasta el comienzo de su próximo turno.
Eltirada de salvación de DC para estos efectos equivale a 8 + su prima de competencia + su modificador de fuerza o Constitución.
Usted puede utilizar esta hazaña un número de veces igual a su bonificación de competencia, y usted recupera todos los usos gastados cuando termina un descanso largo.

feats.name: Strixhaven Initiate
entries: You have studied some magical theory and have learned a few spells associated with Strixhaven University.

Choose one of Strixhaven's colleges: Lorehold, Prismari, Quandrix, Silverquill, or Witherbloom. You learn two cantrips and one 1st-level spell based on the college you choose, as specified in the Strixhaven Spells table.
You can cast the chosen 1st-level spell without a spell slot, and you must finish a long rest before you can cast it in this way again. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have.
Your spellcasting ability for this feat's spells is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (choose when you select this feat).

feats.name: Strixhaven Mascot

feat: strixhaven initiate|scc

entries: You have learned how to summon a Strixhaven mascot to assist you, granting you these benefits:

items: You can cast the {@spell find familiar} spell as a ritual. Your familiar can take the form of the mascot associated with the college you chose for the Strixhaven Initiate feat: a {@creature spirit statue mascot|scc} (Lorehold), an {@creature art elemental mascot|scc} (Prismari), a {@creature fractal mascot|scc} (Quandrix), an {@creature inkling mascot|scc} (Silverquill), or a {@creature pest mascot|scc} (Witherbloom).
When you take the {@action Attack} action on your turn, you can forgo one attack to allow your mascot familiar to make one attack of its own with its reaction.

If your mascot familiar is within 60 feet of you, you can teleport as an action, swapping places with the familiar. If your destination space is too small for you to occupy, the teleportation fails and is wasted. Once you teleport in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest, unless you expend a spell slot of 2nd level or higher to do it again.

Your familiar can take the form of the mascot associated with the college you chose for the Strixhaven Initiate feat: a {@creature spirit statue mascot|scc} (Lorehold), an {@creature art elemental mascot|scc} (Prismari), a {@creature fractal mascot|scc} (Quandrix), an {@creature inkling mascot|scc} (Silverquill), or a {@creature pest mascot|scc} (Witherbloom).

Once you teleport in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest, unless you expend a spell slot of 2nd level or higher to do it again.

feats.name: Svirfneblin Magic
entries: You have inherited the innate spellcasting ability of your ancestors. This ability allows you to cast {@spell nondetection} on yourself at will, without needing a material component. You can also cast each of the following spells once with this ability: {@spell blindness/deafness}, {@spell blur}, and {@spell disguise self}. You regain the ability to cast these spells when you finish a long rest.
Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for these spells, and you cast them at their lowest possible levels.
entries_es: Has heredado la habilidad innata de la spellcasting de tus antepasados. Esta capacidad le permite echar {@spell nondetection} a su voluntad, sin necesidad de un componente material. También puede lanzar cada uno de los siguientes hechizos una vez con esta habilidad: {@spell blindness/deafness}, {@spell blur}], y {@spell disguise self}. Recuperas la capacidad de lanzar estos hechizos cuando terminas un largo descanso.
Inteligencia es tu habilidad de lanzamiento para estos hechizos, y los lanzas a sus niveles más bajos posibles.

feats.name: Tavern Brawler
entries: Accustomed to rough-and-tumble fighting using whatever weapons happen to be at hand, you gain the following benefits:

items: You are proficient with improvised weapons.
Your unarmed strike uses a {@damage d4} for damage.
When you hit a creature with an unarmed strike or an improvised weapon on your turn, you can use a bonus action to attempt to grapple the target.

Your unarmed strike uses a {@damage d4} for damage.
When you hit a creature with an unarmed strike or an improvised weapon on your turn, you can use a bonus action to attempt to grapple the target.

feats.name: Telekinetic
entries: You learn to move things with your mind, granting you the following benefits:

items: You learn the {@spell mage hand} cantrip. You can cast it without verbal or somatic components, and you can make the spectral hand {@condition invisible}. If you already know this spell, its range increases by 30 feet when you cast it. Its spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.

As a bonus action, you can try to telekinetically shove one creature you can see within 30 feet of you. When you do so, the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw ({@dc 8} + your proficiency bonus + the ability modifier of the score increased by this feat) or be moved 5 feet toward you or away from you. A creature can willingly fail this save.

entries_es: Como un {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, puedes empujar telekinetically una criatura que puedes ver dentro de 30 pies de ti mismo. Cuando lo hace, el objetivo debe tener éxito en una tirada de salvación de fuerza ([TAG1]] más el modificador de habilidad de la puntuación aumentado por esta hazaña y su {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}) o ser movido 5 pies hacia o lejos de usted.

feats.name: Telepathic
entries: You awaken the ability to mentally connect with others, granting you the following benefits:

items: You can speak telepathically to any creature you can see within 60 feet of you. Your telepathic utterances are in a language you know, and the creature understands you only if it knows that language. Your communication doesn't give the creature the ability to respond to you telepathically.

You can cast the {@spell detect thoughts} spell, requiring no spell slot or components, and you must finish a long rest before you can cast it this way again. Your spellcasting ability for the spell is the ability increased by this feat. If you have spell slots of 2nd level or higher, you can cast this spell with them.

feats.name: Thrown Arms Master
entries: You've honed your ability to lob weaponry into the fray, including weapons not meant for ranged combat. You gain the following benefits:

items: Simple and martial melee weapons without the thrown property have the thrown property for you. One-handed weapons have a normal range of 20 feet and a long range of 60 feet, while two-handed weapons have a normal range of 15 feet and a long range of 30 feet.
Weapons that already have the thrown property increase their short range by 20 feet and their long range by 40 feet for you.

When you miss with a thrown weapon attack using a light weapon, the weapon returns to your grasp like a boomerang at the end of your turn, unless something prevents it from returning. You can catch and stow as many weapons as you threw in this way.

entries_es: Has perfeccionado tu habilidad para meter armas en la fray, incluyendo armas no destinadas a combates. Usted gana los siguientes beneficios:

items: Simple and martial melee weapons without the thrown property have the thrown property for you. One-handed weapons have a normal range of 20 feet and a long range of 60 feet, while two-handed weapons have a normal range of 15 feet and a long range of 30 feet.
Weapons that already have the thrown property increase their short range by 20 feet and their long range by 40 feet for you.

When you miss with a thrown weapon attack using a light weapon, the weapon returns to your grasp like a boomerang at the end of your turn, unless something prevents it from returning. You can catch and stow as many weapons as you threw in this way.

feats.name: Thrown Weapon Fighting
entries: When you hit with a ranged attack roll using a weapon that has the {@itemProperty T|XPHB|Thrown} property, you gain a +2 bonus to the damage roll.
entries_es: Cuando golpeas con un tirada de ataque con un arma que tiene la propiedad [[TAG0], ganas un bono +2 al tirada de daño.

feats.name: Tough
entries: Your hit point maximum increases by an amount equal to twice your level when you gain this feat. Whenever you gain a level thereafter, your hit point maximum increases by an additional 2 hit points.
entries_es: Su punto de impacto aumenta máximo por una cantidad igual al doble de su nivel cuando usted gana esta hazaña. Cada vez que usted gana un nivel después, su punto de impacto aumenta máximo por un 2 puntos de éxito adicionales.

feats.name: Tough
entries: Your {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum increases by an amount equal to twice your character level when you gain this feat. Whenever you gain a character level thereafter, your {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum increases by an additional 2 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.
entries_es: Su {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} aumentos máximos por una cantidad igual al doble de su nivel de carácter cuando usted gana esta hazaña. Cada vez que usted gana un nivel de caracteres después, su {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} aumentos máximos por un 2 adicional {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}.

feats.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
entries: When you make an extra attack as a result of using a weapon that has the {@itemProperty L|XPHB|Light} property, you can add your ability modifier to the damage of that attack if you aren't already adding it to the damage.
entries_es: Cuando usted hace un ataque adicional como resultado de utilizar un arma que tiene la propiedad {@itemProperty L|XPHB|Light}, puede añadir su modificador de habilidad al daño de ese ataque si usted no está añadiendo ya el daño.

feats.name: Tyro of the Gauntlet
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Stand as One
entries: When an ally within 5 feet of you is subjected to an effect that would push or pull it, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to prevent that ally from being pushed or pulled. To receive this benefit, the ally can't have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.
entries_es: Cuando un aliado dentro de 5 pies de usted es sometido a un efecto que empujaría o tirara, usted puede tomar un {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} para evitar que el aliado sea empujado o tirado. Para recibir este beneficio, el aliado no puede tener la condición {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB}.

entries.name: Vigilant
entries: When you take the {@action Ready|XPHB} action, the next attack roll made against you has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} before the start of your next turn.
entries_es: Cuando tomes la acción {@action Ready|XPHB}, el próximo tirada de ataque hecho contra ti tiene {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} antes del comienzo de tu siguiente turno.
Ganas los siguientes beneficios.

feats.name: Unarmed Fighting
entries: When you hit with your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} and deal damage, you can deal Bludgeoning damage equal to {@damage 1d6} plus your Strength modifier instead of the normal damage of an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}. If you aren't holding any weapons or a {@item Shield|XPHB} when you make the attack roll, the {@dice d6} becomes a {@dice d8}.
At the start of each of your turns, you can deal {@damage 1d4} Bludgeoning damage to one creature {@condition Grappled|XPHB} by you.
entries_es: Cuando golpeas con tu {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB} y haces daño, puedes tratar el daño de Bludgeoning igual a {@damage 1d6} más tu modificador de fuerza en lugar del daño normal de un {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}. Si usted no tiene ninguna arma o un {@item Shield|XPHB} cuando usted hace el tirada de ataque, el {@dice d6} se convierte en un {@dice d8}.
Al comienzo de cada uno de sus turnos, puede tratar {@damage 1d4} Desenmascarando daños a una criatura {@condition Grappled|XPHB} por ti.

feats.name: Vampiric Exultation
entries: As an action, you can transform the lower half of your body into an inky black vapor, allowing you to float through the air. While transformed, you have a flying speed of 30 feet. You can maintain this form for up to 10 minutes. Once you use this ability, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.
entries_es: Como acción, puede transformar la mitad inferior de su cuerpo en un vapor negro inky, lo que le permite flotar a través del aire. Mientras se transforma, usted tiene una velocidad de vuelo de 30 pies. Puedes mantener este formulario hasta 10 minutos. Una vez que usas esta habilidad, no puedes usarla de nuevo hasta que termines un breve o largo descanso.

feats.name: Vigor of the Hill Giant

feat: strike of the giants|BGG|strike of the giants (hill strike)

entries: You've manifested the resilience emblematic of hill giants, granting you the following benefits:

items.name: Bulwark
entries: When you are subjected to an effect that would move you at least 5 feet or give you the prone condition, you can use your reaction to steady yourself. You aren't moved and don't have the prone condition.
entries_es: Cuando usted está sujeto a un efecto que le movería por lo menos 5 pies o le daría la condición propensa, puede utilizar su reacción para mantenerse firme. No te mueves y no tienes la condición de prono.

items.name: Iron Stomach
entries: Whenever you eat food as part of a short rest and spend one or more Hit Dice to regain hit points, you regain additional hit points equal to your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus.
entries_es: Cada vez que comes comida como parte de un breve descanso y pasas uno o más Hit Dice para recuperar puntos de éxito, recuperas puntos de éxito adicionales iguales a tu Modificador de Constitución + tu bonificación de competencia.
Usted ha manifestado la resiliencia emblemática de los gigantes de las colinas, concediéndole los siguientes beneficios:

feats.name: Vital Sacrifice
entries: You've learned secrets of {@variantrule hemocraft|TDCSR} that grant you esoteric power at the price of your own life force. As a bonus action, you can choose to take {@damage 1d6} necrotic damage to gain a blood boon. Your blood boon lasts for 1 hour or until expended.
You can expend this blood boon to gain one of the following benefits:

items: When you make an attack roll, you roll {@dice 1d6} and add it to the total.
When you hit with an attack or spell, you deal an additional {@damage 2d6} necrotic damage.
When you cause a creature to make a Strength, Destreza, or Constitution {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw}, roll a {@dice d4} and reduce their save by the amount rolled.

entries: The damage you take to gain a blood boon can't be reduced in any way.
entries_es: Has aprendido secretos de {@variantrule hemocraft|TDCSR} que te otorgan poder esotérico al precio de tu propia fuerza de vida. Como una acción de bonificación, usted puede elegir tomar {@damage 1d6} daño necrótico para ganar un boon de sangre. Su boón de sangre dura 1 hora o hasta que se expulsa.
Usted puede gastar este boón de sangre para obtener uno de los siguientes beneficios:

items: When you make an attack roll, you roll {@dice 1d6} and add it to the total.
When you hit with an attack or spell, you deal an additional {@damage 2d6} necrotic damage.
When you cause a creature to make a Strength, Destreza, or Constitution {@quickref saving throws|PHB|2|1|saving throw}, roll a {@dice d4} and reduce their save by the amount rolled.

entries_es: El daño que tomas para ganar un boón de sangre no se puede reducir de ninguna manera.

feats.name: War Caster
entries: You have practiced casting spells in the midst of combat, learning techniques that grant you the following benefits:

items: You have advantage on Constitution saving throws that you make to maintain your {@status concentration} on a spell when you take damage.
You can perform the somatic components of spells even when you have weapons or a {@item shield|phb} in one or both hands.

When a hostile creature's movement provokes an opportunity attack from you, you can use your reaction to cast a spell at the creature, rather than making an opportunity attack. The spell must have a casting time of 1 action and must target only that creature.

entries_es: Has practicado hechizos de casting en medio del combate, técnicas de aprendizaje que te otorgan los siguientes beneficios:

items: You have advantage on Constitution saving throws that you make to maintain your {@status concentration} on a spell when you take damage.
You can perform the somatic components of spells even when you have weapons or a {@item shield|phb} in one or both hands.

When a hostile creature's movement provokes an opportunity attack from you, you can use your reaction to cast a spell at the creature, rather than making an opportunity attack. The spell must have a casting time of 1 action and must target only that creature.

entries.name: Reactive Spell
entries: When a creature provokes an {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB} from you by leaving your reach, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to cast a spell at the creature rather than making an {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB}. The spell must have a casting time of one action and must target only that creature.

El hechizo debe tener un tiempo de casting de una acción y debe apuntar sólo a esa criatura.

feats.name: Weapon Master
entries: You have practiced extensively with a variety of weapons, gaining the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency with four weapons of your choice. Each one must be a simple or a martial weapon.

entries_es: Ha practicado extensamente con una variedad de armas, obteniendo los siguientes beneficios:

items: You gain proficiency with four weapons of your choice. Each one must be a simple or a martial weapon.

feats.name: Weapon Master
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Mastery Property
entries: Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery property of one kind of Simple or Martial weapon of your choice, provided you have proficiency with it. Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can change the kind of weapon to another eligible kind.
entries_es: Su entrenamiento con armas le permite utilizar la propiedad de dominio de un tipo de arma simple o marcial de su elección, siempre y cuando tenga competencia con ella. Cuando termines un {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, puedes cambiar el tipo de arma a otro tipo elegible.
Ganas los siguientes beneficios.

feats.name: Wood Elf Magic
entries: You learn the magic of the primeval woods, which are revered and protected by your people. You learn one druid cantrip of your choice. You also learn the {@spell longstrider} and {@spell pass without trace} spells, each of which you can cast once without expending a spell slot. You regain the ability to cast these two spells in this way when you finish a long rest. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for all three spells.
entries_es: Aprendes la magia de los bosques primitivos, que son venerados y protegidos por tu gente. Aprendes una pista druida de tu elección. También se aprenden los hechizos {@spell longstrider} y {@spell pass without trace}, cada uno de los cuales se puede lanzar una vez sin gastar una ranura de hechizo. Recuperas la capacidad de lanzar estos dos hechizos de esta manera cuando terminas un largo descanso. La sabiduría es tu habilidad de spellcasting para los tres hechizos.

feats.name: Zhentarim Ruffian
entries: You gain the following benefits.

entries.name: Exploit Opening
entries: When you roll damage for an {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB}, you can roll the damage dice twice and use either roll against the target.
entries_es: Cuando usted hace tirar daño por un {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB}, usted puede tirar los dados de daño dos veces y utilizar ambos rollos contra el objetivo.
